Créez votre personnage grâce à une personnalisation très complète, et allez plus loin avec vos tenues et vos styles. Choisissez n'importe quel style de combat, sans crainte d'être coincé : vous pouvez en changer à tout moment.

C'est un MMORPG, alors sortez vous faire des amis sur qui compter face aux grands boss. Créez ou rejoignez une guilde. Participez à des activités sociales comme des danses ou des feux d'artifice. Explorez le monde ensemble et participez à des raids.

Le jeu propose à la fois du contenu détente et du contenu de combat : chacun devrait y trouver son bonheur.

623.descriptionLongue:
Raven2 is a free-to-play open-world MMORPG developed and published by Netmarble. Described as a “brutal dark fantasy” the game features classes that fit well with the environment, such as Assassin, Night Ranger, Destroyer, and Deathbringer, among others. Players can customize their characters using a customization system that caters to their visual tastes and style.

In the game’s story, players take on the role of a member of a Special Corps bearing what’s known as a “Cursed Stigma”. They’ll investigate strange phenomena taking place across the world, vanquishing demons and uncovering the world’s secrets.

In addition to the story content, the game offers large scale PvP. This is in the form of guild battles.

tradLongue.fr:
Raven2 est un MMORPG gratuit en monde ouvert développé et édité par Netmarble. Présenté comme de la « dark fantasy brutale », il propose des classes en accord avec son univers, dont Assassin, Night Ranger, Destructeur et Deathbringer, entre autres. On personnalise son personnage selon ses goûts et son style.

Dans l'histoire, on incarne un membre d'un Corps spécial portant ce qu'on appelle un « Stigmate maudit ». On enquête sur d'étranges phénomènes à travers le monde, on terrasse des démons et l'on perce les secrets du monde.

En plus de l'histoire, le jeu propose du JcJ à grande échelle, sous forme de batailles de guildes.

624.descriptionLongue:
Battlefield REDSEC is an independent, free-to-play battle royale mode for Battlefield 6. The game offers a new spin on the battle royale genre using Battlefield’s Dna, offering a massive and fast-paced experience featuring squad play. Players compete in teams with those that survive making their way into the knockout-style elimination mode, Gauntlet.

Battle takes place in Fort Lyndon, a blacksite set in Southern California. The military facility is set up between beaches and a residential community, offering players a variety of terrain to compete on. The terrain is destructible, allowing players to open pathways when needed or destroy enemy cover. When in the Gauntlet, players will race to complete missions as well as eliminate their foes. In addition, REDSEC offers players access to a sandbox area where they can build their own maps for free.

config.graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060, AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT 6GB, Intel Arc A380

625.descriptionLongue:
Compete in fast-paced 3v3 football matches of a different kind in Pathea Games’ free-to-play competitive sports game Superball. Choose from a variety of heroes, each with their own unique abilities. Work together as a team filling the role of goalkeeper, midfielder, or forward in matches that take approximately five minutes to complete while enjoying the cyberpunk feel of the game’s arenas.

To win, players will need to work together to combine their characters’ unique abilities to execute the best moves. They’ll want to be careful, though, as each character has their own weaknesses as well.

As players level up, they’ll improve their equipment and earn accessories, allowing them to show off their own style while playing.

tradLongue.fr:
Affrontez-vous dans des matchs de football rapides en 3c3, d'un genre différent, dans Superball, le jeu de sport compétitif gratuit de Pathea Games. Choisissez parmi de nombreux héros, chacun avec ses capacités uniques. Jouez collectif en tant que gardien, milieu ou attaquant, dans des matchs d'environ cinq minutes, dans des arènes à l'ambiance cyberpunk.

Pour gagner, il faut combiner les capacités uniques des personnages pour réaliser les meilleures actions. Mais attention : chaque personnage a aussi ses faiblesses.

En montant de niveau, on améliore son équipement et l'on gagne des accessoires pour afficher son style en jouant.

626.descriptionLongue:
Explore tenth-century China in Everstone Studio and NetEase Games’ open-world ARPG, Where Winds Meet. Featuring MMO elements, the game allows players to design their own character and take up the role of a young sword master (or mistress), exploring the nation following a personal disaster. Travel through the wilderness, villages, and cities. Meet a wide cast of characters. Uncover long-hidden secrets. The game features Wuxia-style combat, allowing players to combine melee, ranged, and stealth depending on the weapons they are using. Those weapons include swords, spears, rope darts, fans, umbrellas, and more. Players can also join different in-game factions to learn even more skills during their travels. Players can choose their difficulty, playstyle, and whether or not to go solo or team up with friends. There are hours of content before the player even leaves the first zone. In addition to combat, players can explore, solve puzzles, take part in leisurely activities, and more.

On the monetization front, Everstone went with a large collection of cosmetics – clothes, accessories, and other items that players can obtain through the shop or other means. Some of these items are available through gameplay.

627.descriptionLongue:
Take sixty-four players, give them cute animal personas, arm them with everything from teeth to machine guns, and throw them into a free-for-all battle to see who comes out on top, and you end up with Super Animal Royale. 

This free-to-play game from Pixile allows players to take on the roles of different animals and fight it out across an abandoned safari park set on an illustrated 2D island. The island is filled with hidden lore that players can discover by either talking to the critters that live there or by looking for clues as they fight to survive.

Players can collect hundreds of different animals and thousands of cosmetic items to customize them with. This includes weapons, outfits, and accessories. Players even have unusual mounts to choose from, like a Hamster Ball or a Giant Emu. As for how to fight, go in alone or team up with three other players.

tradLongue.fr:
Prenez soixante-quatre joueurs, donnez-leur des allures d'animaux mignons, armez-les des dents jusqu'aux mitrailleuses, et lâchez-les dans une mêlée générale pour voir qui l'emportera : vous obtenez Super Animal Royale.

Dans ce jeu gratuit de Pixile, on incarne différents animaux qui s'affrontent dans un parc safari abandonné, sur une île illustrée en 2D. L'île regorge d'histoires cachées, à découvrir en parlant aux bestioles qui y vivent ou en cherchant des indices tout en luttant pour survivre.

On peut collectionner des centaines d'animaux et des milliers d'objets cosmétiques pour les personnaliser : armes, tenues et accessoires. Il y a même des montures insolites, comme une boule de hamster ou un émeu géant. Pour le combat, partez seul ou en équipe avec trois autres joueurs.

628.descriptionLongue:
Grab your rum and hoist the sails in Thera Ineractive’s free-to-play MMORPG set during the Golden Age of sailing. Featuring dozens of historical ships – some filled with pirates – World of Sea Battle offers both PvE and PvP play as players take to the sea, captaining customizable historical ships such as schooners, brigantines, frigates, and more.

Players will engage in battle on the sea, fighting in both PvE and PvP naval battles and using a variety of artillery. When not fighting, they can explore the Endless Sea and work to accumulate enough gold to afford their own private island outpost, where they can mend ships and increase their fortune via mines and workshops. And they’ll want all the gold they can get, because that’s how everything is achieved in the game.

As for accumulating that gold, there are plenty of options ranging from raiding merchant ships to building trade empires, and more. To be truly successful in the game, it is suggested that players team up with friends. Guilds will be the best way to do that.

config.processor: Intel Core i5-4570 3.2 GHz or AMD Phenom(tm) II X4 B60 3.3 GHz

629.descriptionLongue:
Set in the post-apocalyptic world of Solaris-3, Wuthering Waves is an open-world action RPG with gacha elements developed and published by Kuro Games. Players take on the role of Rover, a character returning to a world recovering from a disaster known as the Lament. Despite obviously being part of this world, Rover has no memory of their past. But they do have an unusual ability, and some people seem to have some idea of who they are. Along the way, Rover meets different Resonators, individuals with varying powers who help them on their journey. These same Resonators are acquired through the game’s gacha system along with their weapons.

The game offers a rotating action-combat system with players swapping between three different Resonators in teams that they’ve built. Players will explore the world of Solaris, fighting monsters, solving puzzles, and completing quests and trials, among other things. The game is updated on an approximately six-week schedule. So there’s almost always something to do.

tradLongue.fr:
Dans le monde post-apocalyptique de Solaris-3, Wuthering Waves est un RPG d'action en monde ouvert avec des éléments de gacha, développé et édité par Kuro Games.

On incarne Rover, un personnage qui revient dans un monde qui se remet d'une catastrophe appelée la Lamentation. Bien qu'il fasse clairement partie de ce monde, Rover n'a aucun souvenir de son passé. Mais il a un pouvoir inhabituel, et certains semblent savoir qui il est.

En chemin, Rover rencontre des Résonateurs, des personnes aux pouvoirs variés qui l'aident dans son voyage. On obtient ces Résonateurs et leurs armes grâce au système gacha du jeu.

Le jeu propose un combat d'action en rotation, où l'on alterne entre les trois Résonateurs de l'équipe que l'on a formée. On explore le monde de Solaris, combat des monstres, résout des énigmes, accomplit des quêtes et des épreuves, entre autres. Le jeu est mis à jour environ toutes les six semaines : il y a presque toujours quelque chose à faire.

630.descriptionLongue:
My Hero Ultra Rumble is a free-to-play 24-player Battle Royale featuring characters from My Hero Academia. Take on the role of one of the many heroes and villains and team up with two other players to win the battle. The game’s roster is made up of five archetypes, including Rapid, Technical, Assault, Support, and Strike. Each character in those archetypes has its own unique Quirk, which can be synergized with the Quirks of the other two members of the team. Players can also make their teams and characters more powerful by collecting items and interacting with NPCs during combat.

As they play, players will be able to make their character more unique using customization earned through experience game and completing missions. Seasonal events also offer players exclusive customization items. Each of the game’s seasons will introduce new elements while adding new characters and costumes.

config.graphics: AMD Radeon HD 7770 / Nvidia GeForce GTX 650 Ti

631.descriptionLongue:
Reign of Guilds is an open-world MMORPG inspired by old-school games like Ultima Online and EverQuest. Players start out by choosing one of fourteen professions and then create their own build using a wide selection of skills, spells, and equipment. They can then further define their build using buffs and items.

Once in the world, players will find that their actions have an impact. If they trade with NPCs, it will affect their prices. Killing mobs has an impact on the population. Even completing quests will have an impact. And since this is an MMO, each player will feel the effects of other players' actions.

The game offers a robust crafting and gathering system and a related market. For players who’d rather not deal with the market, there’s also the possibility of finding items they need by seeking out hidden merchants, abandoned homesteads, and the like.

The game world is broken up into zones with different danger levels. Green zones are safe. Yellow Zones are neutral, and killing others will cost karma. Karma lost becomes experience and items lost upon death. Black zones are dangerous areas where players are fighting for resources, and as a result, the karma isn’t impacted. But experience and items are lost upon death anyway. Finally, Red Zones are war areas, so death is to be expected but not punished.

tradLongue.fr:
Reign of Guilds est un MMORPG en monde ouvert inspiré des jeux à l'ancienne comme Ultima Online et EverQuest. On commence par choisir l'un des quatorze métiers, puis l'on crée sa propre configuration avec un large choix de compétences, de sorts et d'équipements, que l'on affine encore avec des bonus et des objets.

Dans le monde, vos actions ont un impact. Commercer avec des PNJ change leurs prix. Tuer des monstres influe sur leur population. Même accomplir des quêtes a un effet. Et comme c'est un MMO, chacun ressent les effets des actions des autres.

Le jeu propose un artisanat et une récolte très complets, avec un marché associé. Pour ceux qui préfèrent éviter le marché, on peut aussi trouver ce dont on a besoin en cherchant des marchands cachés, des fermes abandonnées et autres.

Le monde se divise en zones de dangerosité différente. Les zones vertes sont sûres. Les zones jaunes sont neutres, et tuer d'autres joueurs coûte du karma ; le karma perdu se traduit par de l'expérience et des objets perdus à la mort. Les zones noires sont dangereuses, on s'y bat pour les ressources et le karma n'est pas touché, mais l'on perd quand même expérience et objets en mourant. Enfin, les zones rouges sont des zones de guerre : la mort y est attendue mais pas punie.

632.descriptionLongue:
Billed as the “first team-oriented free-to-play game” made using the Dragon Ball IP, Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra allows players to build teams from all their favorite Z Warriors and their enemies (or in many cases, frienemies) to compete in 4v4 battles. The cross-platform MOBA features top-down gameplay in three different modes: Standard Battle, Land Grab, and Finders Keepers.

Standard Battle has players eliminating the Gods of Destruction in order to claim the Dragon Ball. This mode features a “Divine Draw” at the beginning that applies two special rules to the match, affecting battle. During battle, players also make use of “Divine Combo Cards” to apply perks to their characters.

Land Grab requires players to capture and hold three points in order to generate points. The match ends when one team earns 500 points. And in Finders Keepers, teams are designated either attack or defense. The attack team works to locate hidden treasure while the defending team tries to keep them from locating it.

Similar to most MOBAs, Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra divides characters into three roles: Damage, Tank, and Technical. Technical provides support. As players progress, in each round, they can upgrade their character, unlocking new attacks and abilities.
Players can also make the characters their own, customizing them with skins, animation enhancements, and more.

config.graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 650 [1 GB] /AMD Radeon R9 270 [2 GB]

633.descriptionLongue:
Umamusume: Pretty Derby is a free-to-play anime-styled gacha sports game in which players collect and race anthropomorphic horse girls. The girls, who are named and modeled after real race horses in Japan, race on tracks designed to replicate the real-world tracks those horses race on. The in-game horse girls also have the same racing records as their real-life counterparts.

Players take on the role of “trainers”, raising and training the Umamusume or “trainee” for races. The Umamusume are obtained via the game’s gacha system along with support cards that offer bonuses and skills. Players choose a trainee, support cards, and a scenario, and work toward goals with each action taking half a month, based on a real racing schedule, and requiring planning.

As players complete or fail different goals and reach different stat totals, they’ll earn potential skills, or “sparks,” that can be passed down as “legacies” and used in future attempts.

In addition to the main Career mode, Umamusume: Pretty Derby also features PvP in the form of Team Trials and Champion’s Meeting races, where players compete against each other for rewards. There’s also a Legend Races mode that allows players to compete against the best, earning rewards and upgrading trainees.

tradLongue.fr:
Umamusume: Pretty Derby est un jeu de sport gratuit au style anime, avec gacha, où l'on collectionne et fait courir des filles-chevaux. Elles portent le nom de vrais chevaux de course japonais et s'en inspirent, et courent sur des pistes qui reproduisent celles où couraient ces chevaux. Elles ont même le même palmarès que leurs modèles réels.

On incarne un « entraîneur » qui élève et entraîne son Umamusume, son « élève », pour les courses. Les Umamusume s'obtiennent grâce au système gacha, tout comme les cartes de soutien qui donnent bonus et compétences. On choisit une élève, des cartes de soutien et un scénario, puis l'on avance vers ses objectifs : chaque action prend un demi-mois, selon un vrai calendrier de courses, ce qui demande de l'organisation.

En réussissant ou en échouant les objectifs et en atteignant différents totaux de statistiques, on gagne des compétences potentielles, les « étincelles », transmissibles comme « héritages » pour les tentatives suivantes.

En plus du mode Carrière principal, Umamusume: Pretty Derby propose du JcJ avec les Épreuves d'équipe et les courses du Champion's Meeting, où l'on s'affronte pour des récompenses. Le mode Courses de légende permet aussi d'affronter les meilleures, pour gagner des récompenses et améliorer ses élèves.

634.descriptionLongue:
Welcome to the city of New Eridu, the last real bastion of mankind following an apocalyptic event that covered the world in large pocket dimensions known as Hollows. Players take on the role of one of two siblings, Bell or Wise, who are together known as Phaethon, a legendary Proxy. Proxies are effectively guides in the Hollows, working together with various agents to explore, fight monsters, and investigate mysteries. It’s not exactly a legal occupation, which is why Phaethon also runs New Eridu’s greatest video store.

Neither of the Phaethon siblings enters the Hollows themselves. Instead, using a special computer setup, they possess a small sentient machine known as a bangboo to lead agents through. It is these agents that players will collect using the game’s gacha mechanic. Each agent belongs to a different faction – some legal, some not-so-much. Their faction alliances, elemental alignments, and roles can impact how each of the three-member teams players can build will work together. Players also roll for different bangboo via the game’s gacha mechanic. They are the fourth member of a team.

Gameplay consists of story missions as well as regular combat content required to obtain leveling materials and endgame battles built around the largest Hollow, Hollow Zero. Players can also expect more casual content, such as running the video store, restoring a temple, and going on hangouts with their agents. They can also adopt a cat.

config.os: Windows 10 64-bit or later versions, DirectX: 11.1 or later versions
config.processor: Intel Core i5 (7th Gen) or AMD equivalent

tradLongue.fr:
Bienvenue à New Eridu, dernier vrai bastion de l'humanité après une catastrophe qui a couvert le monde de grandes poches dimensionnelles appelées Hollows. On incarne l'un des deux frère et sœur, Belle ou Wise, connus ensemble sous le nom de Phaethon, un Proxy légendaire. Les Proxies sont des guides dans les Hollows, qui accompagnent différents agents pour explorer, combattre des monstres et enquêter sur des mystères. Ce n'est pas vraiment un métier légal, d'où le fait que Phaethon tient aussi le meilleur vidéoclub de New Eridu.

Ni l'un ni l'autre n'entre lui-même dans les Hollows : grâce à un ordinateur spécial, ils prennent le contrôle d'une petite machine consciente appelée bangboo pour guider les agents. Ce sont ces agents que l'on collectionne grâce au système gacha du jeu. Chacun appartient à une faction, certaines légales, d'autres beaucoup moins. Leur faction, leur élément et leur rôle influencent la façon dont les équipes de trois fonctionnent ensemble. On tire aussi au sort différents bangboos, qui forment le quatrième membre de l'équipe.

Le jeu propose des missions d'histoire, du combat régulier pour obtenir des matériaux de progression, et des combats de fin de jeu autour du plus grand Hollow, Hollow Zero. Il y a aussi du contenu plus détente, comme tenir le vidéoclub, restaurer un temple ou passer du temps avec ses agents. On peut même adopter un chat.

635.descriptionLongue:
Heartopia is a life simulation game created by XD featuring online play. Players create a character and move into a small town that can host up to 12 players, each with their own customizable land and houses. Players help out each other and the local citizens of the town, engage in fun activities, and uncover the mysteries behind the town and the island it’s on.

Players pick up hobbies: gardening, cooking, fishing, pet raising, and more, all of which help in building the ultimate home. Players have a lot of options for creating their dream home, expanding their property, and designing the interior and exterior to their liking. Players can even ask their friends in-game to help them build their dream house.

Dress up your characters with a variety of outfits obtained via the town store or the game’s gacha system. Adopt cute animals. Go fishing, explore, and play mini games. Players can even throw parties and invite their friends.

config.processor: Intel Core i5 2500 or AMD FX-4350

tradLongue.fr:
Heartopia est un jeu de simulation de vie de XD, jouable en ligne. On crée son personnage et l'on s'installe dans une petite ville qui accueille jusqu'à 12 joueurs, chacun avec son terrain et sa maison à personnaliser. On s'entraide entre joueurs et avec les habitants, on participe à des activités amusantes, et l'on perce les mystères de la ville et de l'île où elle se trouve.

On se lance dans des loisirs (jardinage, cuisine, pêche, élevage d'animaux de compagnie et plus encore), qui aident tous à bâtir la maison idéale. Les options ne manquent pas pour créer la maison de ses rêves, agrandir son terrain et aménager l'intérieur et l'extérieur à son goût. On peut même demander à ses amis de nous aider à construire.

Habillez vos personnages avec une foule de tenues, obtenues à la boutique de la ville ou grâce au système gacha. Adoptez d'adorables animaux. Pêchez, explorez et jouez à des mini-jeux. Vous pouvez même organiser des fêtes et inviter vos amis.

636.descriptionLongue:
Arknights: Endfield is a free-to-play RTS RPG with gacha elements. The game features an anime style and is set in the Arknights universe. Players take on the role of a character known as the “Endminstrator” of Endfield Industries, an organization tasked with defending humanity and expanding their presence on the mostly-untamed planet of Talos-II.

Endministrators achieve their goals by leading teams of operators made up of powerful individuals. These operators are obtained via the game’s gacha system.

In addition to the usual combat seen in gacha RPGs, Arknights: Endfield also features a factory management system that players will use to expand their reach on Talos-II, helping tame the wilds outside of the established Civilization band. Players also use elements of factory construction to solve puzzles and explore the game’s world.

config.storage: 50GB free space or higher. (Requires an additional 40GB of free storage for unpacking)

tradLongue.fr:
Arknights: Endfield est un RPG de stratégie en temps réel gratuit, avec des éléments de gacha, au style anime, dans l'univers d'Arknights. On incarne l'« Endministrateur » d'Endfield Industries, une organisation chargée de défendre l'humanité et d'étendre sa présence sur Talos-II, une planète encore largement sauvage.

L'Endministrateur atteint ses objectifs en dirigeant des équipes d'opérateurs, des personnes aux pouvoirs puissants, obtenues grâce au système gacha.

En plus des combats habituels des RPG gacha, Arknights: Endfield propose un système de gestion d'usines, qui sert à étendre son influence sur Talos-II et à apprivoiser les terres sauvages au-delà de la zone civilisée. La construction d'usines sert aussi à résoudre des énigmes et à explorer le monde.

639.descriptionLongue:
Explore the world of Britannia with the next generation of heroes and some of your favorite characters in Netmarble’s open-world RPG. The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin follows the story of Prince Tristan of the Kingdom of Liones as he and his friends go on an epic journey to fix the issues caused by temporal distortions. Luckily, they have the help of a device that allows them to reverse time.

The gacha game is based on the popular manga and anime, allowing players to add well-known characters, as well as new ones, to their roster. Build the best team to deal with the world’s various monsters and bosses as you explore the landscape and put things right.

In addition to the hero collecting and combat, the game offers several types of relaxing activities, such as fishing, cooking, and crafting. Players can also uncover hidden dungeons, track down treasure, and just enjoy the journey.

tradLongue.fr:
Explorez le monde de Britannia avec la nouvelle génération de héros et certains de vos personnages préférés dans le RPG en monde ouvert de Netmarble. The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin suit le prince Tristan du royaume de Liones, qui part avec ses amis pour un voyage épique afin de réparer les troubles causés par des distorsions temporelles. Heureusement, ils disposent d'un appareil qui permet de remonter le temps.

Ce jeu gacha tiré du célèbre manga et anime permet d'ajouter à son équipe des personnages bien connus et de nouveaux venus. Formez la meilleure équipe pour affronter les monstres et les boss du monde, tout en explorant les paysages et en remettant les choses en ordre.

En plus de la collection de héros et des combats, le jeu propose plusieurs activités détente, comme la pêche, la cuisine et l'artisanat. On peut aussi découvrir des donjons cachés, chercher des trésors, et simplement profiter du voyage.

640.descriptionLongue:
Project Entropy is a 3d sci-fi MMO strategy game that throws you into a unstable galaxy where civilizations rise, collide, and disappear. As a commander, you don’t just lead a fleet, you shape entire alien societies, each with unique technologies, strengths, and ways of fighting for survival across the stars.

Your journey takes you across unexplored planets and shifting star systems filled with danger, opportunity, and constant conflict. Every world you encounter can be conquered, harvested, or lost to rival commanders competing for control of the same expanding frontier.

Combat is built around deep customization and tactical decision-making. You’ll assemble specialized hero fleets, upgrade advanced mechs, and refine weapon systems to match your strategy, whether that’s overwhelming force, precise strikes, or coordinated multi-layered assaults in PvP and PvE battles.

Beyond warfare, Project Entropy is shaped by alliances, seasonal updates, and a living galaxy that never stays the same for long. Join players worldwide, adapt to ever-changing conditions, and uncover the deeper mystery behind a universe slowly drifting toward chaos.

tradLongue.fr:
Project Entropy est un MMO de stratégie de science-fiction en 3D qui vous plonge dans une galaxie instable, où des civilisations naissent, s'affrontent et disparaissent. En tant que commandant, vous ne dirigez pas seulement une flotte : vous façonnez des sociétés extraterrestres entières, chacune avec ses technologies, ses forces et sa façon de lutter pour survivre parmi les étoiles.

Votre voyage vous mène à travers des planètes inexplorées et des systèmes stellaires changeants, remplis de dangers, d'opportunités et de conflits permanents. Chaque monde rencontré peut être conquis, exploité, ou perdu au profit de commandants rivaux qui se disputent la même frontière en expansion.

Le combat repose sur une personnalisation poussée et des choix tactiques. On assemble des flottes de héros spécialisées, améliore des mechas avancés et affine ses systèmes d'armes selon sa stratégie, que ce soit la force brute, les frappes précises ou les assauts coordonnés sur plusieurs fronts, en JcJ comme en JcE.

Au-delà de la guerre, Project Entropy est façonné par les alliances, les mises à jour saisonnières et une galaxie vivante qui ne reste jamais longtemps la même. Rejoignez des joueurs du monde entier, adaptez-vous à des conditions sans cesse changeantes, et percez le mystère profond d'un univers qui glisse lentement vers le chaos.

641.descriptionLongue:
Foundation: Galactic Frontier is a large-scale sci-fi strategy title based on Isaac Asimov’s Foundation series and the Apple TV adaptation.

Developed by FunPlus’s Chengdu studio in partnership with Pa ramount Television Studios, Foundation: Galactic Frontier casts players as "traders" venturing into deep space to build crews, form alliances, and wage massive interstellar battles. The title features sophisticated strategy mechanics and cinematic storytelling, designed to appeal to both long-time fans of the Foundation saga and newcomers to the universe.

In this game, every decision carries weight. Players can choose moral cooperation to repel galactic threats or embrace self-interest to seize control and power. They can explore the comforts of their flagship "homestead" or command vast space armies in large-scale wars.

Since its beta phase in late 2024, Foundation: Galactic Frontier has added a portrait mode, additional ships, expanded narratives, and a variety of seasonal events. Players can recruit an eclectic mix of companions and customize a fleet of original ships crafted with input from designers who previously worked on Fallout, Stargate, and Star Wars.

tradLongue.fr:
Foundation: Galactic Frontier est un jeu de stratégie de science-fiction à grande échelle, tiré du cycle Fondation d'Isaac Asimov et de son adaptation sur Apple TV.

Développé par le studio de FunPlus à Chengdu, en partenariat avec Paramount Television Studios, Foundation: Galactic Frontier fait des joueurs des « marchands » qui s'aventurent dans l'espace lointain pour former des équipages, nouer des alliances et mener d'immenses batailles interstellaires. Avec des mécaniques de stratégie poussées et une narration cinématographique, il vise aussi bien les fans de longue date de la saga Fondation que les nouveaux venus.

Chaque décision compte : on peut choisir la coopération pour repousser les menaces galactiques, ou l'intérêt personnel pour s'emparer du pouvoir. On peut profiter du confort de son vaisseau amiral, son « domaine », ou commander de vastes armées spatiales dans des guerres à grande échelle.

Depuis sa bêta fin 2024, Foundation: Galactic Frontier a ajouté un mode portrait, de nouveaux vaisseaux, des récits plus riches et de nombreux événements saisonniers. On peut recruter des compagnons très variés et personnaliser une flotte de vaisseaux originaux, conçus avec l'aide de designers ayant travaillé sur Fallout, Stargate et Star Wars.

642.descriptionLongue:
Welcome to Hethereau, a city where humans live side by side with the supernatural, and individuals with special abilities known as “Espers” are tasked with dealing with anomalous threats. In Hotta Studio’s urban open-world action RPG, players take on the role of a special Esper, designated “Esper Zero,” who, in their role as the Appraiser at Eibon Antique Shop, helps hunt anomalies and deal with other problems in the city. Neverness to Everness is a gacha game that blends some GTA/Saint Row-style play with team-based combat and supernatural mysteries. The game is set in a city filled with plenty to explore. Simply walking to the corner store could be filled with danger, with anomalous activity happening frequently and plenty of characters to interact with. As players explore, they’ll be able to interact with friends on a regular basis, developing bonds and earning rewards for doing so.

In addition to their job as the Appraiser, players can engage in other activities, including working at various shops to earn money for cars, apartments, and more. As their friendships develop, they can invite characters to their home, take them on rides in their car, or simply hang out and go on dates. Other activities include fishing and racing. Just don’t get caught breaking the law, or you will spend time in jail. NTE also boasts multiplayer features. These include things like games of Mahjong at the local maid cafe. Or, if you’re looking for something more daring, how about a bank heist? It’s the kind of activity that demands friends.

config.graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 / INTEL ARC A580

643.descriptionLongue:
Set in New York City, Ubisoft’s The Division Resurgence is an open-world shooter that can be played alone or in co-op. Explore areas based on the city’s most well-known locations while completing over 100 activities and experiencing the story of a plot threatening the city.

The game offers plenty of variety when it comes to weapons and gear. Players can easily customize them using skins and cosmetics as well. Weapons and gear are obtainable via gameplay (looting and crafting), as are some skins and cosmetics.

In the game’s storyline, players are part of a first wave of SHD agents, choosing a specialization that fits them, complete with signature weapons and gadgets. During this story, they’ll learn more about the events of Division 1 & 2. Players can either experience the story alone or bring along friends in co-op mode.

As for PvP, players can head to a PvPvE area known as the Dark Zone. There, they can compete solo or with a team, earning gear and other rewards as they do.

tradLongue.fr:
Dans la ville de New York, The Division Resurgence d'Ubisoft est un jeu de tir en monde ouvert, à jouer seul ou en coopération. Explorez des zones inspirées des lieux les plus célèbres de la ville, accomplissez plus de 100 activités et vivez l'histoire d'un complot qui menace la ville.

Le jeu offre une grande variété d'armes et d'équipements, faciles à personnaliser avec des apparences et des objets cosmétiques. Armes et équipements s'obtiennent en jouant (butin et artisanat), comme certaines apparences et certains cosmétiques.

Dans l'histoire, on fait partie d'une première vague d'agents de la SHD, avec une spécialisation adaptée, ses armes et gadgets signature. On en apprend aussi plus sur les événements de The Division 1 et 2. On peut vivre l'histoire seul ou avec des amis en coopération.

Côté JcJ, on peut se rendre dans une zone JcJcE appelée la Zone sombre, pour s'affronter seul ou en équipe et gagner de l'équipement et d'autres récompenses.

644.descriptionLongue:
Experience World of Tanks in a whole new way with World of Tanks: HEAT. Rather than just being built around tanks, the 5v5 and 10v10 hero-driven PvP game asks players to choose from a roster of unique Agents with varying abilities to pilot upgradable tanks in combat. Between the two, players can create a playstyle that appeals to them.

As Wargaming built World of Tanks: HEAT, they also built a completely new engine to support it, creating a visual environment that allows players to feel every action. Improved combat visuals, particle effects, and VFX all enhance the experience.

World of Tanks: HEAT is a cross-platform game available on PC, Steam Deck, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and GeForce Now. It features both cross-platform play and progression.

config.graphics: NVIDIA GeForce® GTX 1050 (2GB) , AMD Radeon™ RX 560 (2 GB), or Intel® Arc™ A310 (4 GB)

645.descriptionLongue:
Crystal Saga Nova is a free-to-play browser-based MMORPG from R2Games. Featuring five playable classes, a guild system, PvP, system and more, the game offers players plenty to do. Explore the world, complete quests, level and train pets, and engage in PvP.

Play as one of five classes: Priest, Ranger, Rogue, Mage, and Knight, with plenty of options to make your character stronger over time. Aside from standard leveling and gear, the pets and mounts provide buffs. Pets can even aid in combat. Crystal Saga Nova also includes wings that look cool while offering players additional stats. Pets, mounts, and wings are all upgradable, offering even higher stats.

In addition to questing and leveling characters, the game offers players plenty of things to do, including dungeons, boss battles, and PvP. Players can earn XP via guild quests and even AFK grinding as well.

tradLongue.fr:
Crystal Saga Nova est un MMORPG gratuit jouable dans le navigateur, de R2Games. Avec cinq classes jouables, des guildes, du JcJ et plus encore, le jeu a de quoi occuper. Explorez le monde, accomplissez des quêtes, faites monter de niveau et entraînez vos familiers, et affrontez d'autres joueurs.

Jouez l'une des cinq classes (Prêtre, Rôdeur, Voleur, Mage et Chevalier), avec de nombreuses façons de renforcer votre personnage au fil du temps. En plus des niveaux et de l'équipement, familiers et montures donnent des bonus, et les familiers peuvent même aider au combat. Crystal Saga Nova propose aussi des ailes, qui ont fière allure et apportent des statistiques supplémentaires. Familiers, montures et ailes s'améliorent tous pour des statistiques encore plus élevées.

En plus des quêtes et de la progression, le jeu propose donjons, combats de boss et JcJ. On gagne aussi de l'expérience avec les quêtes de guilde, et même en mode AFK.

646.descriptionLongue:
Gamigo’s Gloria Victis is a free-to-play open-world medieval MMORPG that combines features from games like Mount & Blade and PlanetSide 2 with an atmosphere reminiscent of The Witcher. Take on a variety of roles: soldier, knight, assassin, huntsman, and more – or all of them – via the game’s class-less progression system. No need to choose, you can build the character you want and even have hundreds of items to choose from to customize your equipment.

Once the character is built, explore the open world and compete against other players for control of territories. Claim land and siege towns and castles. Build your own fortifications to defend against those who would attack you. Just be aware of where you’re traveling, because some areas of the map are riskier than others – although the rewards increase to match. In some of these areas, players will be able to choose the loot they want from defeated enemies, but only within a limited amount of time.

The game’s medieval low-fantasy setting will appeal to those players looking for something a bit more realistic. As players explore, they’ll come across forests, swamps, ruins, snowy mountaintops, and more. They’ll also uncover ancient secrets and dig up plenty of treasure.

config.processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Athlon II X4 with at least 2,7 GHz
config.graphics: GeForce GT 740, Radeon HD 7750 - at least 2GB GPU memory

647.descriptionLongue:
RF Online Next is a sci-fi PvP MMORPG set on the world of Novus, where humanity must fight against machines. Some members of humanity have evolved into beings known as Scions and can use Arcane relics and Biosuits in combat. The suits act as an artificial body and allow them to fly and swap abilities mid-combat as needed.

RF Online Next hosts faction battles that reward the winning teams with key resources and a share of taxes from the game’s market. The game also features a full storyline with various regions and dungeons for players to explore. Fight world bosses and take part in world and server-wide battles.

tradLongue.fr:
RF Online Next est un MMORPG JcJ de science-fiction sur le monde de Novus, où l'humanité doit combattre les machines. Certains humains ont évolué en êtres appelés Scions, capables d'utiliser au combat des reliques arcaniques et des Biosuits. Ces combinaisons servent de corps artificiel et permettent de voler et de changer de capacités en plein combat.

RF Online Next propose des batailles de factions qui récompensent les vainqueurs avec des ressources clés et une part des taxes du marché du jeu. Il propose aussi une histoire complète, avec diverses régions et donjons à explorer. Affrontez des boss mondiaux et participez à des batailles à l'échelle du monde et du serveur.

649.descriptionLongue:
An indie game that spent a decade in development, Chaomoon’s Soul’s Remnant is a 2D platformer MMORPG featuring a classless skill system that allows players to build their characters from a library of more than 72 combat and life skills.

The game features pretty much everything players expect from an MMORPG, including a party system, guilds, and friends lists. New players will find a dedicated community that grew over the ten years of development already built in.

The game offers more than 200 maps for players to explore and plenty of quests to complete, monsters and bosses to fight, and more to keep them busy. This includes a crafting and gathering system with fishing, mining, and herbalism. Gear is craftable, and players have plenty to choose from, including hundreds of weapons.

tradLongue.fr:
Jeu indépendant qui a passé dix ans en développement, Soul's Remnant, de Chaomoon, est un MMORPG de plateforme en 2D, avec un système de compétences sans classes qui permet de construire son personnage à partir de plus de 72 compétences de combat et de vie.

Le jeu propose à peu près tout ce qu'on attend d'un MMORPG, dont les groupes, les guildes et une liste d'amis. Les nouveaux venus trouveront une communauté fidèle, déjà formée au fil de ces dix ans de développement.

Le jeu offre plus de 200 cartes à explorer, de nombreuses quêtes à accomplir, des monstres et des boss à combattre, et bien plus pour rester occupé. Cela comprend un artisanat et une récolte avec pêche, minage et herboristerie. L'équipement se fabrique, et le choix est vaste, avec des centaines d'armes.

650.descriptionLongue:
Stoke Games’ free-to-play tank shooter Tyr features a full roster of customizable armored vehicles and pilots. Each vehicle has its own tech tree and unique abilities, allowing players to modify it to suit their style. This includes the possibility of changing the vehicle’s main tech.

An important gameplay mechanic in Tyr revolves around vision. Being able to spot other players depends on them either being in range or making enough noise to be detected. Players will need to be tactical about deciding when and how to move, since they could be the ones being spotted.

The game is completely free-to-play, with no gacha or pay-to-win. Better tanks and other game-affecting items re not available in the shop.

config.processor: Intel® Core™ i7-8700K or AMD Ryzen™ 5 5600X
config.graphics: NVIDIA GeForce® GTX 1070 or Radeon™ RX 580

651.descriptionLongue:
Explore the continent of Idyll, uncover secrets, and befriend the cutest and fluffiest creatures who will aid you in your journey. In Pawprint Studio’s free-to-play open-world creature collecting game, players will take on the role of Pathfinders, exploring the continent with the aide of their Aniimo friends. Explore different biomes, each filled with their own unique Aniimo that can be tamed and nurtured, aiding players with everything from combat to puzzle solving.

In Aniimo, players form a connection with the creatures by “Twining” with them, allowing them to command the creature in combat and also take on their form for combat and exploration purposes. As they explore and level, the player’s will be able to level and evolve the Aniimo, adding even more powerful creatures to their roster. Each Aniimo features unique abilities, such as the ability to fly, swim, or set things on fire, that players can use to traverse the world and uncover its secrets.

Aniimo offers players an expansive solo experience, but they don’t have to play alone. In addition to running into players in the open world, players can also take part in the “Egg Heist” PvPvE mode, joining a 3-player team to search the Lost Isles. On the social end, players will also be able to own their own RV and park it at a campsite where they can hang out with other players. Returning to the Homeland with the RV allows players to plant crops and create their own space. As you’d expect from a creature collecting game, Aniimo also allows players to test their team in duels.

652.descriptionLongue:
NC’s Aion 2 is set 200 years after the events of the original Aion and expands on the lore of the original game with a world that’s 36 times larger and built around vertical travel, allowing players to explore and fight in air, on the land, and in the sea.

Aion 2 features an extensive character customization system, allowing players to create something unique and expands on that with cosmetics, a mount/pet system, and class options. The game boasts a large quantity of PvE content, such as large-scale raids, solo challenges, group content, and more. It also offers faction-based PvP.

653.descriptionLongue:
SPAM is a free-to-play turn-based card collecting game developed and published by Ticroco Enterprise. During gameplay, players build decks using cards of varying rarities with different talents and hidden synergies to compete against other players. As players progress and collect more cards, they gain access to more combat combinations.

During a match, players will be able to upgrade their cards using the Tox Shop to create more combos. And, as they progress their decks will become even more specialized.

SPAM features a ranked mode with a competitive ladder. It also offers the option to challenge friends to duels.

654.descriptionLongue:
Netmarble’s free-to-play MMORPG, Vampir, invites players to live in a dark world of vampires, where the immortal fight each other for control. Take on the roles individuals capable of using blood or the power of darkness in combat in a war between factions where the winners take control.

Choose to play as one of five classes: Grim Reaper, Carnage, Viper, Bloodstained, or Akasha. Use your own flesh and blood to create weapons as the vampire knight Bloodstained. Use guns powered by blessed blood as the Carnage class. Turn the power of darkness into curses as the Viper. Carve out souls as the Grim Reaper. Or, turn your own body into a weapon as the Akasha.

For those with less violent tendencies, the game also features a robust economy system with resource farming and crafting. Vampir is rated Mature, for players over 17.

655.descriptionLongue:
Developer and Publisher Armative Studios’ free-to-play tank MMO Steel Aces takes a different approach from other games. Rather than progress being dependent on spending, this game focuses on the players’ skill. Featuring tanks from various eras, ranging from World War I to modern-times, Steel Aces allows players to pilot hundred of vehicles based on real-world ones from all over the world.

Steel Aces focuses solely on tanks. The game offers no player-controlled artillery or aerial gameplay. This means players will need to be very aware of their surroundings since they don’t know when they’ll run into another tank ready to take them out.

Rather than simply trying to deplete a health bar, players will have to learn how to take advantage of their opponents’ weak spots. This means taking the time to develop knowledge and skills in order to climb the ranks in the game.

As for monetization, Steel Aces features cosmetics and collections. Players can also purchase items to help accelerate progression.

config.graphics: GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 570

219.description: Half-Life 2 defines a new benchmark in gaming with startling realism and responsiveness. Powered by Source™ technology, Half-Life 2 features the most sophisticated in-game characters ever witnessed, advanced AI, stunning graphics and physical gameplay.

410.description: Help yourself to a generous, 11-level serving of Portal: First Slice, the official demo for the game that challenges you to think with portals. The winner of numerous Game of the Year awards introduces you to the test chambers at the Aperture Science Enrichment Center, where you'll learn to solve physical puzzles by opening portals to...

1522.description: Inspired by the 1983 cult classic film, Wargames, DEFCON superbly evokes the tension, paranoia and suspicion of the Cold War era, playing on the fascinating aspects of psychological gameplay that occur during strategic nuclear warfare. You play a General hidden deep within an underground bunker.

29150.description: Step away from the computer! Welcome to Mightier, the action puzzler that pulls you away from the screen to solve puzzles by hand with pencil and paper. Using a color printer and web camera, the game prints puzzle pages for you to draw on, then captures the results when you're done.

31500.description: Coil is an experimental "autobiographical" game that plays out more like a song or painting then an actual "game". I was basically trying to create an experience that put the player into an open minded space and let them question not only what the game was about, but what a game can actually be.

34050.description: The Napoleon: Total War demo will take you through the new and playable "War on Land" tutorial as well as the epic land Battle of Ligny, one of the many historical scenarios included in the full version of the game. War on Land tutorial - Set during the Siege of Toulon, you will be given command of the French artillery battery.

35110.description: The Just Cause 2 demo features a massive 35 square miles of the Lautan Lama Desert, a vast expanse of stunning, sun-scorched scenery taking up just one of the many islands in the 400 square miles of the Panau archipelago.

231250.description: Resident Evil® Revelations returns redefined for PC complete with high quality HD visuals, enhanced lighting effects and an immersive sound experience. This latest version of Resident Evil Revelations will also deliver additional content including a terrifying new enemy, extra difficulty mode, integration with and improvements to Raid...

241700.description: Vector is an exciting, arcade-style game featuring you as the exceptional free runner who won’t be held down by the system. The game opens with a view into a totalitarian world where freedom and individually is nothing more than a distant dream. But the heart of a freerunner is strong, and you soon break free.

246640.description: TorqueL is a 2D action game where the player must move and manipulate a cube to progress.To complete each stage, the player must make their way to the blue square.This version consists of the prototype released at the end of March as well as extra content developed for the E3 Indicade Showcase.

247750.description: The Stanley Parable is a first person exploration game. You will play as Stanley, and you will not play as Stanley. You will follow a story, you will not follow a story. You will have a choice, you will have no choice. The game will end, the game will never end.

273130.description: Dracula, weak and yearning release from immortality, must reclaim his powers and defeat Satan. An epic fantasy adventure set in an expansive modern-day world! Awoken after centuries of slumber, weakened and yearning for release from his immortal bonds, Dracula must reclaim his powers and make a pact with Death, to defeat Satan and gain...

285540.description: Among the Sleep is a first person horror adventure, in which you play a two year old child. After waking up in the middle of the night to mysterious sounds, you start exploring the dark looking for comfort.

299130.description: Delve into Linda's nightmare before her real journey begins.

309890.description: DubWars is a music game that combines the mechanics of a top-down shooter with the power of Dubstep and Electronica music. Your weapons are synced to the music creating times of intense weapon load outs and calm moments where your survival skills are tested.

317560.description: The world’s first underwater stealth trivia game! Play as a foreign exchange diver student in a school for dolphins, cheating, sabotaging, and manipulating your way through classes, extracurricular activities, and fellow classmates!

323760.description: Dandelion -Wishes brought to you- is a female-oriented game developed by Cheritz. The game was released in South Korea in August, 2012. The English translation for Dandelion was released on Nov, 2012. Dandelion is known as a unique dating simulation with a sensational storyline and charming characters.

334660.description: What's NEKOPARA? Why, it's a cat paradise! Kashou Minaduki, the son of a long line of Japanese confection makers moved out to open his own shop "La Soleil" as a patisserie.

340740.description: You are Kayto Shields, an ordinary man thrown into an extraordinary adventure. Control Kayto's day to day life as well as his responsibilities as club manager in this stat management sim.

362710.description: fault - milestone two side:above is a Cinematic Visual Novel that takes place right after the events of milestone one. Please note that this novel is a direct sequel to fault - milestone one and contains massive spoilers of the first story. Play through of the first title is highly advised.

372500.description: Demo of Secrets of Grindea, a fantasy Action RPG. It's playable by yourself or in co-op with up to three friends! Features an unrestricted skill system, fluid and challenging combat, and an engaging story. For additional value, there's also a fleshed out, challenging roguelike mode!

375890.description: XCOM meets Football Manager. Develop your club, earn experience in turn-based matches, learn new skills, achieve new classes, upgrade your facilities, buy and sell footballers, grow your youth academy, make difficult choices. It's a deep strategy game that respects your time.

393500.description: Fran Bow is a creepy adventure game that tells the story of Fran, a young girl struggling with a mental disorder and an unfair destiny.

421830.description: This prototype beta will give you an early look at Indivible's gameplay. Indivisible is an action-packed new RPG from developer Lab Zero, creators of the critically acclaimed Skullgirls!

445440.description: Suoh Shirahane, a girl with a mysterious past, will begin her first year of high school at Saint Angraecum Academy. Follow her as she navigates friendships and mysteries at her new school. As love begins to bloom between the budding young women, who will you choose?

589120.description: A new cast of 16 characters find themselves kidnapped and imprisoned in a school. Inside, some will kill, some will die, and some will be punished. Reimagine what you thought high-stakes, fast-paced investigation was as you investigate twisted murder cases and condemn your new friends to death.

617070.description: Love, Money, Rock'n'Roll: romanticism of the Eighties, mysteries and intrigues, betrayal and self-sacrifice, hatred and passion – all of this in the new game by the creators of the legendary visual novel "Everlasting Summer"!

632810.description: Play sounds in voice chats in high digital quality. Add sounds or music to your microphone signal so others will hear it, too.

818110.description: Total Tank Simulator is a physics-based WW2 game. Experience WW2 like never before. Play with tanks, planes, cannons, infantry and much more. Deploy your units before the battle and issue orders. Watch the battle or take control over every unit on the battlefield.

1110960.description: Design and simulate the starship of your dreams! Command it in epic battles and manage your crew while exploring a dangerous galaxy. Play alone or with friends, test your ship in online PvP, and let your imagination reach for the stars!

1131860.description: Live the memorable experience of a first-person, story-driven adventure and puzzle game! Avoid traps, use your Jetpack and Taser-Gun to think your way through Zero-Gravity puzzles of this mysterious space station.

1221010.description: 《千恋＊万花》是日本美少女游戏品牌Yuzusoft（柚子社）2016年制作的一款和风恋爱题材作品。本作发售后展现出了势如破竹的高人气，并获得萌系游戏大赏的年度准大奖以及Getchu美少女游戏大赏中获得综合类排名第一的殊荣，在剧本、系统、图像、音乐、影片、角色等多个奖项中也均有斩获。

1223730.description: Trials of Mana Free Demo Available Now!

1239190.description: Have you ever thought about expanding your own crime empire, without the legal and moral consequences? SIMULATE IT!. Now you will finally be able to crawl into the dark alleys of the drug dealing business! Become a street business mastermind, or a ruthless gangster - it's up to you!

1292810.description: The Rewinder is an adventure puzzle game, based on Chinese mythology. You play as Qi Yun, the last known Rewinder, who can communicate with spirits and explore other people memories to alter the past.

1318040.description: Shady Knight is a first-person skill-driven melee action game centered around swift swordplay, acrobatic archery, and fluid platforming that seamlessly blends combat and parkour skills into a stylish dance of death.

1340560.description: Necrofugitive is a 2D stealth-action game about an evil shapeshifter on the run from justice. Survive a world forged through Medieval history with merciless pursuers, daring escapes, and an ancient mystery driving your every move.

1394770.description: Venture deep into the Neverlooted Dungeon in search of its legendary treasure, and face its treacherous, deadly traps. Using your creativity and magical items in a highly interactive physics-based world, find your own ways to outsmart the dangers, and be the first to uncover its darkest secrets.

1412570.description: In this demo for Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin, players are able to play the opening portion of the game for free. Save data from the demo can be carried over to the retail version. Mount up and get ready to experience an all new RPG adventure set in the world of Monster Hunter.

1445220.description: Wind Runners is a high-speed bullet-hell dogfighting roguelite where you start as a lone pilot, turning each flight into a fight for freedom. Face the ruthless technotheist Realm, take on relentless fleets and colossal bosses, and let your victories ignite a growing resistance across the star system

1531850.description: Play the first 4 levels of Advent NEON for free!

1579160.description: Due to work, Wu Shengyou was forced to leave home for high school in a big city. The sensitive, introverted poet felt out of place with classmates.As they grew closer, he seemed her only friend, yet appeared to completely misunderstand her inner thoughts...

1650980.description: Defend against waves of alien monsters in this unique roguelike action miner. Dig for resources, collect useful gadgets, and upgrade equipment to increase odds of survival – just hurry back before your dome is destroyed!

1718790.description: Kusan: City of Wolves is a high-octane hardcore top-down shooter set in a brutal urban jungle ruled by gunfire and corruption. Play the demo and wishlist today.

1764210.description: Develop your newspaper and become New York’s new media mogul! In this tycoon, build and manage your newspaper from printer to toilet. Create your editorial line and lead your journalists through unique 1930's stories and dig out the latest scoops!

1832190.description: The dark tale of a princess who must corrupt her own soul in order to save her kingdom, reaping death and sorrow along the path.

1837770.description: Inspired by classic The Elder Scrolls games, Ardenfall is a first-person, open-world RPG of ancient cultures and rival factions. Explore windswept plains and forgotten dungeons, forge your path with steel, magic, or persuasion, and shape the fate of those you meet.

1871580.description: A paper airplane, two new neighbors, four autumns, and a one of a kind life. Create an experience that’s all your own in this near-fully customizable, choice-heavy story where you grow from childhood to adulthood.

1887390.description: You have only one shot at stopping God of Death. One shot at everything. Pass platforming challenges, explore, solve really dumb puzzles, fight bosses, make choices affecting the story, try to save the world, and fail. Dark humor. Multiple endings. Regret.

1950950.description: Play the opening of Mouseward and get introduced to the world of Terrene. Take up your sword and uncover the secrets of a cursed kingdom in this soulslike collectathon. Awaken as a Royal Mouse Guard, master combat, defeat foes and search for celestial fragments to restore a once great kingdom.

1972540.description: Taste of heaven is a 2D cooking RPG with a pinch of roguelite ! Master the art of crafting dishes for celestial gourmets while forging bonds with a cast of unforgettable characters. Discover hidden recipes and explore a vibrant, ever-changing world brimming with charm and mystery.

1976900.description: Vanquish the Kaiser's Imperial Fleet using timing, tactics and telegraphy in MORSE, a minimalist strategy game that teaches you the lost language of Morse code. Can you change the world with the push of a button?

videos.nom: MORSE exhibited at HAM RADIO 2026 - Friedrichshafen

1986140.description: First loves. Family issues. Yokai. 'Last Time I Saw You' is a coming-of-age adventure set in 1980s Japan. Explore a haunted forest hiding a terrible secret, and interact with a vast cast of friendly and dubious characters in this beautifully hand-drawn story with some light action elements.

videos.nom: Last Time I Saw You - Launch Trailer
Last Time I Saw You - Release Date Trailer

2054460.description: Alone on Halloween? How pathetic. Learn and choose how to live your sorry life, talk to a series of surreal visitors and witness the unspeakable in this highly interactive and atmospheric life simulator.

2093150.description: Adorable spider chaos! Swing around the house, weave crazy structures, play with physics-based objects, and pull off chores with nothing but your webs and your wits in this madcap sandbox adventure.

2098190.description: You are trapped in HOPE, a masked cult where pain is salvation. Every thought is tallied. Every smile is a lie. Conform for happiness, or face your guilt to escape.

videos.nom: NAME OF THE WILL Release Window and Publisher Announcement Trailer - ENGLISH

2179510.description: Lost and Found Co. is a hidden object adventure in a cozy and immersive world. Join a cast of quirky characters on their epic journey across countless magical locations. Find lost items, solve puzzles, and help a tiny dragon regain her power!

2208650.description: A village in peril. A samurai reanimated. An Oni advancing. Fight an army of undead warriors and Japanese monsters as a human, a Kodama, and a cat in this 2D stop-motion action adventure.

2251070.description: Germany, 1956. The war is over, but justice is not served. Former Nazis walk free, while their victims lie in unmarked graves. As a prosecutor, you'll unearth long-buried evidence, confront witnesses and hunt down perpetrators. Will you have the courage to bring these "ordinary men" to court?

2255190.description: Arm your vehicle with deadly weapons and roam endless wastelands in this fast-paced single-player / online co-op car combat game. Collect upgrades for your car to melt enemies and giant bosses in this bizarre world. Retro vibe. Retro cars. Retro gameplay!

videos.nom: FUMES Gameplay Trailer - PC Gaming Show 2024
FUMES - Early Access Date Reveal Trailer

2264070.description: Light up your fantasy with extra lives ✈︎ ⋆｡˚A new type of bishoujo game combining "bullet hell shooting" and "visual novel."

2325930.description: In this demo for tactical martial arts roguelike Forestrike, you can get an early taste of the game’s unique Foresight ability. Practice a battle as many times as you like in your mind—but if you're defeated in the actual fight, your run ends.

2336830.description: Rogue Blight is a rogue-lite with focus on souls-like combat, featuring a Slay The Spire-inspired map system. Fight your way through ever-changing maps. Customize your playstyle based on what you find. Death is punishing. Only skill and persistence will carry you forward.

2351590.description: Take on the role of a twelve-year-old boy in this puzzle platformer about the journey home through the most terrifying of nightmares. Each playthrough is unique: the choices you make affect the types of skills and locations, the story's progression, and its ending.

2375120.description: Command vast armies across the surface of a star-encompassing Dyson Sphere in this next-gen RTS. Shatter the map itself with superweapons, freeze oceans to create new invasion routes, and control hundreds of units in your quest to dominate humanity's greatest megastructure.

2382030.description: A sci-fantasy roguelite deckbuilder set in a world collapsing under cosmic instability. To stop the turmoil, humanity created a white-haired, godlike girl with overwhelming power and social anxiety. Enter the Vortex Zone, summon your allies, form your battle line, and tear through the enemy forces.

videos.nom: Voice of Belldona - Echoes of Distant Deep Days

2391460.description: Two spirits wake up separated in a broken world, with no memory of what they once were. Control them simultaneously in an atmospheric journey about separation, memory, and the hope of becoming whole again.

2398180.description: Grappling hook. Hoverboard. Guns. Featuring singleplayer and online co-op. By the creators of Severed Steel.

2404130.description: Coach a sports team of Beasties in this turn-based volleyball RPG! Your Beasties' relationships power up their teamwork!

2415020.description: Weaponize your WPM. Glyphica: Typing Survival is a single-player roguelite horde survival game that lets you mow down hordes of enemies in a minimalistic arena using your finger dexterity, your choice of weapons loadout, and sheer determination.

2423690.description: Luna Abyss is a single player story driven action-adventure with fluid platforming and bullet hell combat. Follow the journey of Fawkes, a prisoner of Luna caught between a cryptic prophecy and their prison sentence.

2426560.description: The glory of Rome is at your fingertips in this city-building game where you must appease the gods, enact laws, and develop complex supply chains to meet the needs of your citizens.

2429670.description: Humanity is gone. You're what's left. Now, it’s time for payback. Exact vengeance as a giant industrial robot rewired for pure destruction. Tear through the alien invasion in BLOW-UP, a Y2K-inspired, chaotic FPS packed with brutal weapons, explosive combat, and relentless action.

2432200.description: The Chef’s Shift is a fast-paced typing game in a restaurant setting, where you’ll both cook & serve food to hungry customers, all done by TYPING. Play through the Italian restaurant and the beginning of the Chinese restaurant in the demo, and serve food to customers!

2432870.description: Lead a strike force against an alien threat in this turn-based tactical RPG from the developers of Battle Brothers. Answer distress calls across different worlds, train and equip infantry, deploy tanks and mechs, and plan and execute missions in detailed turn-based battles.

2464930.description: A FARMING SIM where you live as a LATIN COWBOY and raise farm animals while diving into a GRAND ADVENTURE exploring the vast grasslands, the cozy highlands, the beach, and a magical world, helping locals and mystical beings to make your world a more harmonious place.

2470480.description: A vampire-slaying pachinko roguelike deckbuilder. Collect a powerful deck of cards, strategize, aim, and pop pegs to power up and deal massive damage with relic synergies. Play as one of the unlikely heroes, conquer Transylvania, and free the people in this turn-based RPG.

2473160.description: Start your dream idol group in this demo of K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut! Manage your first six weeks as a K-pop manager by discovering trainees, scheduling their weekly training and activities, and guiding them toward debut success.

videos.nom: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut | Release Date Announcement

2519730.description: Outsmart your past self in a battle of cause and effect. Explore an interconnected clay world, discover its hidden rules, and uncover the secrets it would rather keep buried.

2522260.description: Explore the small island of Stowaway's Step that sits just off the coast of Erenshor. The island serves as a prologue to the main game, and features 5-10 hours of content. Encounter battles, complete quests, find magic spells, and work to find a way off the island.

2533590.description: Rummage through the abandoned profiles of an old PC to unravel an inherited mystery. What secrets hide in this eerie adventure of cryptic games and outdated software? Who was using this computer? And what happened to them? Can you complete this demo?

2538290.description: IT HAS YOUR FACE. Now it wants your life. Hide, seek, and try to kill your clone in this deceptively simple first-person horror roguelite.

2542360.description: A handcrafted pixel art action-adventure RPG featuring fast, skill-driven combat with katana and spirit bow, challenging bosses, environmental puzzles, and handcrafted biomes set within a cursed forest inspired by Japanese folklore.

2549340.description: PARKSIDE is an FPS-Immersive Sim that chronicles the future of biomechanical subterfuge and suffering. Shoot, hack, and either save or sour the future of humanity in the dystopian city of Abbotsford, California in the awful year of 2038. Will you serve the Divine Rod?

2569190.description: Gennady is a dynamic roguelike platformer where you fight your way through ever-changing corridors filled with chthonic creatures, and death only makes you stronger. All wrapped in legendary absurdity and classic Earthworm Jim-era animation.

2582150.description: In Ruffy and the Riverside, you wield the magic SWAP to Copy & Paste textures - turn ice into lava or waterfalls into vines! Explore, fight, skate on straw bales, and unleash your imagination in this quirky open-world action game. Dive into an adventure that lets you literally change the world!

2616730.description: A squirmy, bouncy shooter filled with lovely sights and horrible places. Careen across the planet, blast yourself to new heights, and discover the dark tunnels and deep places of a world beneath our own.

2620510.description: After saving an exiled prince of the fallen State of Wei, you are granted an abandoned homestead. Farm the land, raise livestock, fish and hunt, forge bonds with the townsfolk, build a militia, and defend your home against invading forces.

2646600.description: Clean up ocean waste in this short & relaxing game! Recycle, earn coins and upgrade your boat. Explore new areas. Clean bigger spills and different kinds of waste!

2649160.description: From the creator of Don't Be Afraid. You are a little girl trapped inside a nightmarish mansion, where twisted residents and dark secrets hide behind every closed door. Explore and uncover the beginning of Alyssa's story in this demo.

2676780.description: Check out the demo for Ground Zero Hero! Battle the mutated fauna of a radiated wasteland. Absorb their forbidden goo and become the ultimate mutant!

2695350.description: MULLET MAD JACK: DEMO is a HIGH-OCTANE-ACTION SHOOTER that put you directly inside a CLASSIC ANIME. Pick your favorite weapon and reach the last floor; Beat your best time or try again. Haste makes waste… OF YOUR ENEMIES! DEMO ONLY

2711590.description: Six months remain before an asteroid hits Earth. And a new leaf is about to turn. A narrative puzzle adventure unfolds in a bleak yet beautiful Seoul. Will you uncover the truth in time?

2714490.description: PROJECT MIX is a VR anime narrative adventure. Can you find happiness after losing everything you once had?

2715110.description: Stranded on a mysterious island with a baby dragon, survive and grow stronger. Gather resources, build your base, and overcome trials left behind by ancient explorers. An open-world survival RPG blending exploration, crafting, combat, and dragon growth.

2717930.description: ARE YOU READY TO BOTSU? It’s the ultimate robo-sport showdown! Compete online or split-screen in a series of ragdoll, physics-based battlesports to prove your mechanical mettle.

2723730.description: An embroidered dark medieval folk tale. While life in a seemingly ordinary village is all about simple chores and idle gossip, sinister secrets hide below.

2732540.description: "JOR: Dawn Dew" is a 2D turn-based game with a box-like map. In the game, act "Dew" to adventure. On adventure, collect and freely choose your way of fighting. As the exploration progresses, deter the threat of the black beast tide, and finally defeat the monstrous malice.

2738220.description: Journey across a Wild West full of dangers where dinosaurs never faced extinction.Battle elements, evade predators, and confront cunning bandits to save your sister.Conquer the untamed frontier, or become prey in this exciting Survival Roguelike!

videos.nom: Dino Path Trail - Release Date Trailer
Dino Path Trail - Steam Next Fest 2025 Trailer

2741670.description: MAKE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP OF MINDSCAPE TOWER. DELVE INTO THE MINDS OF YOUR OPPONENTS IN THIS MICROGAME FRENZY. BE CONSUMED BY THE TRUTH THEY SPEAK TO YOU, IN THE CEREBRAL BATTLE OF SIGHT AND SOUND HIDDEN WITHIN EACH OF US.

2750510.description: Dragged into a dark conspiracy, explore and survive your way through the beginning of the end for the nation of Australia. Use your wits and instinct to stay alive in this 2000s-style first person liminal exploratory horror shooter set down under during the 1990s.

2753240.description: The city of Neo-Talis is under threat as chromatic monsters have swarmed the Adicia power plant! Lead your own noble family of inquisitors as they cleanse the city, grow in power and make friends with eccentric nobles to - hopefully - save the city from disaster.

2764410.description: Set off to the unknown world Stargather Land now. The shadow of chaos is shrouding here for so long, a girl from another world shoulders the responsibility of saving this land. Travel with the power of elements until the end of destiny, only fight will lead her to the finish.

2778240.description: Immerse yourself in a first-person urban RPG, powered by dice and intrigue. This demo is the start of a journey where you might even shape the fate of a city. Whatever it takes to get the gig, right?

videos.nom: Moves Of The Diamond Hand Trailer 1

2779630.description: Escape the Mad Empire is a party-based, rogue-like dungeon crawler with intense and deeply tactical combat. Overcome the challenges as a band of heroes, and preserve their lives and sanity by managing resources and growing your base. Can you Escape the Mad Empire?

2782660.description: Can you survive an evil King who kills a bride every night by telling stories? A story-crafting game based on a unique narrative system — Become the storyteller Scheherazade from Persian folklore, weave tales to the King through typing, and guide his words to forge magical weapons for your revenge!

2783450.description: Disco-punk space horror where you can be a sneaky chap or a mutant action hero as you try to survive on a space station swallowed by a black hole. A mind-bending ride with weird creatures, immersive features, time jumps, and '70s mustaches!

2794290.description: A deadly plague threatens the village of Grimshire. Manage your farmland, forage the bounty of the wilds, prevent your harvest from rotting away and keep the root cellar full. Can you help bring the community together and survive?

2811660.description: POLY IMPULSE is a minimalist fast-paced movement FPS where you will have to shoot colorful polyhedrons to impulse yourself through the level. Speedrunning is not an option, only the fastest with godlike aim will get the SS rank.

videos.nom: POLY IMPULSE - Official Release Date Trailer

2822250.description: Explore a vast underground world to mine, refine and craft hundreds of items, building up your modular surface Outpost to prospect for gems, farm hydroponic crops, and automate your resource-gathering in this sci-fi survival-crafter where the story always provides a reason to dig deeper.

2824290.description: Experience the first day in Alo’s month-long story in this demo. Talk to loved ones over video calls, work from home as a video editor, sort through puzzles to rediscover childhood memories and get to know yourself better. Fishbowl is a slice of life visual novel about grief and self discovery.

2825060.description: Use luscious plants to turn your ordinary home into a green haven in Urban Jungle. Find the best place for each plant in your small apartment and enjoy gardening without worries. And don't forget to pet your cat!

2825840.description: Build massive ocean cities and lead your people to prosperity in this post-apocalyptic survival colony sim. Featuring a physics-based 3D construction system, complex resource management, exploration, difficult political decisions, supply chains, and a robust sandbox mode.

2833530.description: From the creators of Game Dev Tycoon comes Tavern Keeper 🍻, a cosy-chaotic management sim, featuring a powerful decoration sandbox and a magical storybook RPG!

2870360.description: Deck-building meets monster catching in this turn-based roguelike. Recruit enemy cards to your party as you dive into the depths of the abyss. Will you kill them or will you tame them?

2875110.description: Congratulations! You just found a 'one of a kind' roguelike that combines deck-building card game and auto battle strategy game! Consider unit counters, then create powerful synergy by breaking down the boundaries between the battlefield and cards, then lead your army to victory!

2879290.description: In an age when humanity gave up on happiness—just to escape unhappiness—and became nothing but bugs. This is the tale of a witch who grips her baseball bat tight... and smashes everything in her path.

2893830.description: Averno City, 1983. Gangs rule the streets and your father lies restless in his grave. Clean up the city, uncover the truth, and embark on thrilling vehicle chases through destructible environments in this neon-noir action sandbox police game.

2895290.description: “Trizna” is a classic plot-driven 2.5D metroidvania filled with intense battles utilizing the unique features of weapons, evasions, parries, and counterattacks. Explore the mysterious and eerie realm deeply intertwined with pagan beliefs, with blade, magic and a keen mind.

2898880.description: Mecha Simultactics is a simultaneous-turn-based competitive tactics game with customizable mechs, anime-inspired battle replays, and online multiplayer PvP.

2908040.description: Distant Oceanic Getaway— A visual novel for sapphics! Will you be able to find true love while sailing the seven seas?
