2924270.description: In this pixel-art dystopian block-pushing puzzler, a shadowy client has hired you to navigate a network of hazardous secret labs. Find a way to clean the scene and destroy the ███████. Take the money, do the job, don’t ask questions.

2924780.description: Enter the world of CHORDIOID, the musical JRPG where you battle to the beat, and get a taste of the action in CHORDIOID: First Breath, a demo spanning the opening chapter of the full game.

2925280.description: Discover the wonders of the Aztec Civilization as you build your own magnificent metropolis in this ancient city builder adorned with beautiful hand drawn 2D graphics. From humble beginnings rise to build, trade and conquer to become Tlatoani (Emperor).

2928230.description: Enter the year 2070 as you step into the shoes of total recluse Detective B to solve a case of social homicide within a cyberpunk world. But what is "social homicide" exactly...?

2940200.description: Run fast, soar through the air, and master your landings as you speed through procedural worlds to outrun the end of the universe!

2941730.description: Bloodthief is an ultra-fast melee dungeon-runner where you use momentum to parkour through hazardous dungeons and brutally slash through enemies. Speed-run through medieval dungeons and castles and learn what dark secrets lie beneath the surface.

2949290.description: 她们中间，有一个是恶魔。

2950480.description: Wax Heads is a cozy-punk narrative sim about working in a struggling record store. Chat to quirky customers with unique tastes, explore a handcrafted record collection, fall in love with bands (and their drama!), or just slack off with your colleagues - whatever gets everyone’s groove back!

videos.nom: Wax Heads Play The Demo Now!

2954120.description: Tower Factory is a tower defense and automation game with roguelite elements. Optimize resource production using conveyor systems while defending against monster waves. Can you find and destroy the enemy tower before it's too late?

2966870.description: Get a taste of justice, firepower, and chaos in the Shotgun Cop Man Demo, a precision platformer from the creator of My Friend Pedro. Armed with a shotgun, a pistol, and three explosive weapons to discover, you’ll dive headfirst into the fiery depths of hell on a mission to arrest the devil himself.

2973670.description: Step into the shoes of hotel owner as you design, build, and manage. Juggle demanding guests, frantic logistics, and plenty of unexpected surprises in Hotel Architect; the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game!

videos.nom: Hotel Architect | Steam Next Fest Demo Trailer

2978840.description: A tactical puzzle game about leading a soccer team of cute pups. Solve puzzles, score goals, and become the Champs!

2981670.description: The King is Watching is a roguelite kingdom builder.Rule by the power of your royal gaze! Decide between producing resources, training armies, or balancing both, while adapting to unique events every run

2983150.description: Rise from the ashes of the Black Plague and create a flourishing metropolis as you lead your people into the Renaissance. Navigate historical events as you build a thriving economy, design beautiful neighbourhoods, recruit famous masters, and raise magnificent landmarks.

2984030.description: Death In Abyss is an intense flight shooter that challenges you to utilize your maneuverability and explosive firepower to survive against the deep-sea hostilities. In your descent, the nightmares can only get worse.

2984660.description: Deep in the forgotten corners of the world, a dark force stirs – the Demon King rises once more. Sharpen your wits, seek out powerful artifacts, and stand firm in the face of the apocalypse in this roguelite RPG auto battler.

2985630.description: Revelation of Decay is a zombie survival game that’s less “scary” and even a bit lively. Explore this pixelated world full of bizarre anomalies, awaken supernatural powers, and, amid endless zombie hordes and mutated monsters, gradually uncover the truth behind the invasion.

2989810.description: Waddle and fly as a duck in space! Explore every corner of the galaxy and find curious creatures and materials along the way. Craft gadgets, upgrade your spaceship, and get cozy in this relaxing adventure.

2993710.description: Stellar Poetry is a 2D action adventure game similar to the galaxy Castlevania. After perceiving the call of a mysterious voice, the witch awakens in order to find her memories and embark on a series of adventures.

2994170.description: Undusted: Letters from the Past Demo is a casual game in which you clean and restore dirty items. Experience the opening chapters of Adora's story as she returns to a long-neglected house. Enjoy the satisfying audiovisuals featuring sensually designed sounds and graphics.

2994870.description: In this modern rendition of young adults seeking adventure, love, and meaning, return to 2011's Castor Yard, tap on your keyboard, and make those letters dance; use your online persona to make meaningful decisions for not only yourself, but your friends and clients.

3007500.description: Hunt the monsters that swarm the Dark Hunting Ground, collect the spoils, develop your skills freely and wisely and fight to become the strongest hunter!

3009420.description: The B.C. Piezophile Demo is an open mecha sandbox designed for the player to familiarize them sylfs with the normal handling procedures of the Strategic Force Multiplying Unit as overseen by the Mercy Envoy Atta’s Council of Esteemed Leapers.

3013400.description: Experience one of the adventures in this demo of Legends of the Round Table. Lead the Knights of the Round Table through King Arthur's legend in a unique RPG, full of honor, magic and romance. Plunge into a colorful world inspired by medieval art, tales and music.

videos.nom: 14 Tips and Details in the game

3018760.description: Untethered is a space survival-sandbox set in our own cosmic backyard. Explore zero-gravity environments, build and operate realistic space stations, and fight to stay alive in the unforgiving realm of deep space.

3019520.description: Elation For The Wonder Box 6000 Demo is a first-person, claymation adventure demo about going into the city to try and find a game from your youth that no one else remembers.

3019920.description: Eclipse 2: Invasion of Darkness – is an isometric, story-driven game in the Action RPG genre, combining the mechanics of metroidvania exploration and the dynamics of modern slashers. Lead the medieval resistance against the alien invasion on Earth!

videos.nom: Eclipse 2: Invasion of Darkness | Gameplay Trailer #1
Eclipse 2: Invasion of Darkness | Story Trailer #1 | ENG

3021340.description: Dive into the Little Big Adventure – Twinsen’s Quest remake with this first ever exclusive demo!

videos.nom: Little Big Adventure – Twinsen’s Quest - Gameplay Trailer

3022140.description: "Herbals tycoon" is a game that combines ancient style with deep management strategy, bringing players into a mysterious and fantastic world of traditional Chinese medicine. Here, you are not only a healer but also an explorer, manager, and inheritor, writing your own herbal legend every moment.

3023890.description: Experience life as a house in this silly adventure game! Play as a building as you roll, jump, and wave-dash across a cozy island. Meet eligible structures, romance them, and experience a bizarre, yet oddly familiar story.. or go fishing instead (though we replaced fish with cars to make more sense)

3029150.description: The NecroDancer's back in an all-new rhythm game! Dragged into a strange new world, Cadence must engage in musical combat with monsters surging through the Rift! Face pulse-pounding Rhythm Rifts where every beat is a battle, all set to an original soundtrack by Danny Baranowsky & friends.

3030630.description: You are assigned by the organization to hunt down the escaped test subjects. Every action unfolds through turn-based card battles— persuasion or reconciliation, conflict or closure, the power of choice is in your hands!

3032700.description: Sunset Devils is a top-down action shooter, Where every weapon's unique controls must be mastered through the thrill of an old west gunfight. A classic spaghetti western story of vengeance, portrayed in stylish pixel art.

3033620.description: A 3D-Platformer where you play as a contract killer and your eyes glaze over.

3036850.description: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure is a pixel-art precision platformer. Fire your floating cannon to trigger switches and move platforms. Grab items to dash with varying charges, directions and distances. Chart a path underground, restart power stations, and uncover the AI Deus's secrets.

3047240.description: Hordes of Hel is a gripping roguelike horde-survivor game set in the dark realms of Norse Mythology. Fight waves of enemies to earn divine blessings of ancient Viking Deities, explore hostile worlds and face powerful bosses. Become a god-like warrior in this ultimate showdown.

videos.nom: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel | Early Access Launch Trailer
Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel | Free Demo Announcement Trailer
Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel - Announcement Trailer

3049150.description: Aaron wakes up in a nation where obedience is survival. As reality bleeds into a surreal nightmare, he isn’t just running from a regime. He is fleeing something far worse. Unravel Aaron's fate. Confront yourself.

3051010.description: Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime is a frog-obsessed comedy adventure featuring tactical frog battles, bizarre quests, and the mother of all frogs: the motherfrogger.

3060260.description: Myths are 100% True is a Fast-Paced Combat-Platformer that feels like X-Files if it was made by 12 year olds back in 2008. This is the Demo of that game.

3089050.description: The story of a lonely young man named Ignat, who survives in the dangerous and gloomy world of post-apocalyptic cyberpunk. You have to face the trials of a new reality and plunge into the secrets of the surrounding chaos.

videos.nom: Hail to the Rainbow Demo - Trailer

3089380.description: Build the ultimate waterpark paradise in this classic tycoon simulation game! Design & customize water slides, pools, and saunas to fulfill your guests' needs. Combine creativity, strategy, and management to make a splash in the world of water parks and become the ultimate Aquapark Tycoon!

3092480.description: Super Alloy Crush is a fast-paced 2D roguelike brawler inspired by classics like Mega Man X. Play as Kelly and Muu (No.02) to defeat enemies and obtain the ultimate cosmic treasure: Planet AE-38. Alone or with a friend in local co-op, get ready for your biggest challenge yet!

3100360.description: 这是《完蛋！我被美女包围了！前传》试用版，开放故事线第一章供大家体验；成就、排行榜、档案等更多功能将在正式版上线，敬请期待！

3100460.description: Build your base on a machine in constant motion, travel through biomes with different resources, and prepare for the night when a zombie threat is much higher than during the day. Would you go solo or explore this new world with your best friends?

3101730.description: Immerse yourself in the first-person perspective, cross time and space, solve bizarre cases, save innocent victims, and catch a mysterious killer! You will solve murders, uphold justice, and also gain love. Are you ready? Play the "Game of Fate" that crosses time and space, life and death!

3110460.description: Verho, a Dark RPG following the tradition of the King’s Field series, takes place after the catastrophic Era of Solitude. Travel to the land of Yariv, find the source of this scourge and face its dangers. The Demo takes around 4-5h to beat.

3112070.description: Become a train station manager. Renovate and upgrade the station building. Expand available services, enhance your skills, and manage staff. Ensure visitor comfort to achieve success in Train Station Project Demo!

3122250.description: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

3126370.description: Establish a home for your industrious mice under the oppressive paw of your cat overlords in this city builder featuring complex simulations, intricate production chains, and the age-old rivalry between cat and mouse.

3126730.description: In this colorful action roguelite, participate in the festivities organized for the pleasure of the warrior god. Equip your best weapons, prove your valor against powerful monsters, and permanently engrave your name in history!

3130820.description: CleanFall is a survival rogue-lite that prizes player freedom and creativity. Build mobile death machines to fight off ravenous hordes, craft and alchemize gun turrets, and tunnel through subterranean ecosystems crawling with nameless horrors.

3131940.description: This is a narrative role-playing game telling the story of a crown prince of the Blessed Arknian Empire. You possess great power, but are also burdened by duty. Can you change the world and stay true to yourself? Every decision comes with a cost.

3132850.description: Slash, kick and magick your way through an adventure brimming with secrets and curious encounters! HARK THE GHOUL offers a meticulously handcrafted world to explore.

3132890.description: Become a master hacker in this Cyberpunk Roguelike Deckbuilder. Explore the dangers of cyberspace and fight evil corporations. Build and upgrade a deck of powerful programs. Unlock perks and skills, and unleash digital hell on your enemies. Dive Into The Grid!

3133310.description: Execute ultra-violent raids in 1970s casino hotels. Take down the Las Vegas mob as a drug super-powered hitman in physics-fueled top-down close combat

3135100.description: Help Artificial Intelligence named HAWKING activate an incredible mechanism that can reload the Universe!

3136430.description: This is the trial version of 'Devil Connection'.Punish the little bastard demon and being punished too! Kemono-Summoning Adventure Game

3142360.description: A narrative survival RPG set in a city under siege. No weapons, no combat, just the choices you make and the people you make them for. Inspired by real events. Made in Ukraine.

3142450.description: Nonogram 3D: Mega puzzle DEMO is a logic and puzzle-solving game. Analyze the hints, then break and paint the puzzles to reveal hidden shapes. Inspired by nonograms (or picross), this 3D variant adds depth to the game while remaining accessible.

3144250.description: DEMO: It's the year 1993. Talking robots, ghosts from the past, and ancient alien technology buried under desert sand. An adventure following Elroy and Peggie in the search of a long lost father. How far would you go to bring back the ones you love?

3144590.description: A first person melee horror game where you use rusty tools to brutalize a gang of serial torturers in the remote Appalachian Forest.

3146800.description: Seed in is a vibrant, 2D, puzzle game that challenges you to dig your way out of ingenious and fun levels! Along the way, you’ll enjoy a relaxing, adorable, and quirky story with memorable and lovable characters!

3152510.description: Build, decorate, and customize every detail of your inn to welcome guests to your cozy escape in the woods. Entertain tourists, farm, cook meals, research wildlife, and ski, all while helping a colorful cast of townspeople save the struggling mountain town from a hostile takeover.

3152580.description: A physics-powered 3D desktop companion engine where crazy ragdoll physics meet living, reactive characters. Import VRM characters, or create your own, and let them live on your desktop.

3154880.description: Make a pilgrimage skybound to the Isle of Reveries, where any wish can be granted. Conquer mysterious dungeons, solve head-scratching puzzles, and fight dangerous enemies in this retro-inspired action adventure.

3155230.description: Card-en-Ciel is a deckbuilding, roguelite RPG adventure featuring over 300 characters and 50 vocal songs. Earn a chance to recruit a new ally with each victory, opening up new strategies and combos.

3157200.description: A mysterious program called “Cupid’s Chatroom” suddenly appears on your PC, transporting you into a private chatroom. You find yourself joined by five others, who have also been dragged into the server—and it turns out they’re your potential bachelors?!

3161620.description: After chance meetings in your second year of college, decide how you want to spend the last two years of undergrad with your friends— both old and new— in this partially customizable amare visual novel.

3162300.description: Act out in the Clever Girls "Dress Rehearsal" demo! Clever Girls is a story-driven, relationship-focused, turn-based DinosauRPG! Outwit poachers with stealth and teamwork while also navigating relationship drama. Experience a brief slice-of-life story and learn the basics of dinosaur combat tactics.

3166530.description: Yuman’s, the player, once solitary home and routine are now invaded by five beautiful women! Each has her unique charm – the 'childhood friend of 20 years,' the 'first love and former idol,' the 'demanding boss,' the 'bold younger girl,' and the 'shy recluse.' Who will you choose?

3169340.description: A single pilot named Alice is sent on a mission to retrieve a stolen magical artifact.

3175750.description: Xenopurge is a tactical auto-battler where you are a Commander tasked with purging the Xenos threat. Operate from a remote command center, issuing indirect orders via multi-screen interfaces. Plan routes, set priorities, and adapt as missions escalate and feel the true weight of being in command.

3176210.description: Co-op horror (1-4 players). You are sent to explore a mysterious building at night. Find the Moon and try to return alive.

3178840.description: Download the Friend's Pass to play Astrumis Survive Together for free with a friend who owns the full game — work together. Or die alone.

3185370.description: Demo Version: Traumatized youth trapped in 'Noise Scramble City', a labyrinth of their own fears. Amnesiac teens solve puzzles in a multi-ending escape adventure.

3185680.description: Gather your party, roll your dice and battle across the islands to put an end to a powerful curse once and for all in this roguelike turn-based tactical RPG!

3186190.description: In Tempus Triad, dive into an ancient first-person horror scenario where a scientist is thrust into an era where huge predators dominate the land.

3188440.description: Aurascope is a 2D action-adventure collectathon platformer with light puzzle and RPG elements. Join our friends Trace and Aurora to uncover the secrets surrounding the Aurascope, a mysterious drive from beyond the stars!

3192850.description: Archons is a Roguelite/Survivor game where you control two characters, the Archons- simultaneously! Customize your build and abilities to fit your own unique playstyle and blast your way through enemy parasites and bosses!

3192990.description: Explore a mysterious and wonderful world in Maseylia: Echoes of the Past, a 3D Metroidvania. Unlock powerful abilities, traverse hidden pathways, and master fluid movement to forge your own path. Face wild creatures and uncover the secrets of a vast, interconnected realm.

3193050.description: Create a new life in the MMO Idle Strategy on the island of Nortopia! Build a fortress, trade with other families, explore dungeons, embark on sea voyages for treasures, and participate in clan battles for power!

3195080.description: Play as a fully-customisable magical die, where each of your faces casts a different spell! In this ‘dice-builder’ strategy RPG, every step is a puzzle of your own design as you discover, combine, and sequence spells to reshape the world around you. But will your talents be worthy of the Tabletop?

3195160.description: Mars Attracts is a park management sim set in the iconic universe of Mars Attacks™. Play as the devious Martians as you construct detailed enclosures, manage staff, and most importantly - abduct and experiment on humans for the entertainment of your Martian guests!

3196880.description: Explore the anomalous space with Elias and his found notes. Wander through endless corridors, uncovering the sinister secrets of the backrooms and the distorted reality.

3199290.description: You will play as a Trainee Death, harvesting Souls to pay off your debt. Random choice events offer you various options: Lie in bed and slack off since the debt is endless anyway, Or follow your senior to earn some extra Souls, collecting outfits to switch up your style.

3202450.description: A sentient guitar trapped inside a nightmare music school. Hide, distract, and survive horrifying creatures as you tune your way through musical puzzles and fractured memories to uncover the truth.

3205720.description: Jump into the streets of Hyland Point and take the first steps from small-time dope pusher to kingpin. Manufacture and distribute a range of drugs to reach the peak of the underworld. Now available in 4-player co-op!

3207090.description: Fast paced Top-down shooter! Smartly use IRCM to evade the constant barrage of bullets and missiles and destroy everything that stands in your way.

3218540.description: White Knuckle is a first-person roguelite speed-climbing game. Ascend through the guts of SUB-STRUCTURE 17 using precision movement mechanics. Sharp reflexes and resource management will bring you out from under ten thousand meters of concrete and decay.

3221930.description: A frantic and challenging boss rush with options to customize your play style as you progress. Defeat all enemies in your path with attacks, specials, parries, and unique abilities.

3224660.description: You’re a lowly blob — but with the ability to evolve any DNA you eat, you don’t have to stay that way. Upgrade parts to fight, run, fly and overcome your environment. Mammals, birds, insects, dinosaurs — everything is on your menu!

3224750.description: "Slot & Dungeons” is a deck-building roguelite in which the placement of enemies and items on the floor changes depending on the slots. While developing your character, collect symbols along the way to enhance the contents of the slots and conquer the dungeon.

videos.nom: GAMBLER │ Slot & Dungeons New Character Trailer

3227230.description: A turn-based tower defense with deep roguelike progression, set in ever-expanding, procedurally generated biomes. Build, farm and defend your village as you push deeper into goblin-infested territory. Unlock powerful upgrades and craft your environment to survive the endless goblin horde.

3227590.description: A narrative-driven game of suspense, crime, and dark humor. Amid exquisitely crafted art and a gripping story, the Wushan Great Buddha's demise unfolds.

3233950.description: Star Fire is a love letter to classic arcade side-scrollers, reimagined with roguelite progression, modern action polish, and that “just one more run” itch. It’s fast, punchy, and all about no-pressure fun with tight combat, slick movement, and endless ways to cause chaos.

3240730.description: Have a human MEATGRINDER with Obi the freelance hitman! Fulfill contracts all over the planet, open a beer, turn off your brain: it's time to kill and solve the financial problems of Obi and her peculiar family!

3248400.description: Dive The Depths is an action-roguelike set beneath the ocean's surface. As a humble diver, you must navigate the world filled with bizarre sea creatures, submerged ruins, and forgotten histories. Can you conquer the depths and unravel the secrets that hidden beneath the waves?

3253810.description: A game that combines visual novel elements with gameplay for vocabulary memorization. With this game, we offer an exciting adventure that transforms word learning into an enjoyable and rewarding experience. Join us now to explore the joy of English learning in this visually immersive game!

videos.nom: 万词破-单词女友 最浪漫、温暖的单词伴侣

3271420.description: Insider Trading is a roguelike deckbuilder where you bend the market to your will. Synergize perks, manipulate stock prices, and trade wisely or risk pricing yourself out.

3273110.description: TetherGeist is a challenging precision platformer that rewards practice and perseverance. Guide Mae and her axolotl spirit, Bao, on a wholesome coming-of-age pilgrimage while mastering Astral Projection, a tether that links Mae to her spirit and is the source of her strength.

3273470.description: In Grochów, something strange is causing the residents to behave abnormally. Three inseparable buddies must restore balance by discovering the causes of this confusion and heading deep into the mysterious Alcoholypse demo. Will they succeed in restoring normalcy before the neighborhood collapses?

3276550.description: A first-person puzzler where light reshapes physics and geometry — a glitch-laced mystery for the people who still keep a portal gun, a camera, and a perspective shift in their library.

3285820.description: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 Demo invites you into the final chapter of the psychological thriller trilogy. With point-and-click mechanics, intricate puzzles, and cinematic cutscenes, immerse yourself in a dark horror experience that redefines the genre.

3289470.description: A cozy idle farming game, watch tiny guys do tasks around the terrace, expand, progress, and decorate your Tiny Terrace.

3290520.description: MEN ARE EXTINCT. ONLY WOMEN REMAIN. Welcome to Eclipse—a choice-driven Yuri VN where God, Kings, Soldiers, and even Villains are all women. As Haesu, an elite agent, your choices will forge her destiny and the very future of the world. Amidst love, desire, and bloodshed—can you handle the truth?

3304480.description: “Person of Serendipity… please help us——” A text-based adventure puzzle game set in ancient villages, where shrine maidens and the Kami guide you to forge unbreakable bonds. Every choice reshapes destiny—you will lead them, but to where?

3307570.description: In this Demo version of the game, you will set up your very first foothold and try to survive in the hostile realm of Rodovia. Bend your subjects to your will with an unusual indirect management system. Plan, build, manage and offer bounties to greedy heroes who may or may not take on the challenge.

3312850.description: A slice-of-life adventure with a comedic-yet-bittersweet story set in a 2000s Japanese neighborhood! Play as 12-year-old Hoshino, revive a summer festival, reconnect with neighbors, and uncover truths about her grandma living with dementia.

3313700.description: Deck of Haunts invites you to become a malevolent Haunted House. Lure humans into your cursed halls, manipulate their fears, and drain their essence to grow your power. Use strategy to build your mansion and expand your dark influence, turning your home into a terrifying, inescapable nightmare.

3316540.description: A plinko-style roguelike where you work at a number factory. Launch your spherical friend, Nubby, down a pegboard to make bigger and bigger numbers! But beware, if you fail to meet your number quota, the sun will explode.

3317110.description: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

3318020.description: Due to "special" work requirements, you've been assigned by your superiors to live in a very remote and desolate villa. You thought your dull and monotonous life would just carry on as usual, but every midnight, strange sounds emanate from the pitch-black attic...What kind of beginning awaits you?

3333390.description: At the northern fringes of the empire, a new Roman city is born! Manage and grow your city, please the gods, and survive against barbarians and mythological threats in this demo of the early portions of the game.

3333570.description: 为了打倒毁灭世界的大魔王，少年和少女们踏上长长的旅途，开启了一段跨越两个世界的恋爱、幻想奇谭。 本作品搭载了中日语的文本和配音，L2D动态立绘以及超过200张的基本CG；此外还有立绘触碰等独特系统。

3340480.description: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

3345060.description: This is the demo version of Kemono Teatime! Relax in the world of Kemono Teatime, where animal ears are a normal part of everyday life. Here in Melodius, you can whip up whatever blends of tea you desire in your favorite cafe as you play through an adorable story.

3350900.description: Fight through the fog in this sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder where clever positioning, explosive chain-reactions, and the environment itself can make the difference between life and death.

3350930.description: Discover hidden truths about the world in this 3D adventure about a giraffe with an unreasonably long neck. Figure out the rules, solve strange mysteries, and stumble upon unexpected twists. Choose your own path.

3352550.description: Embark on an over-the-top, modern-day pirate adventure with an ex-yakuza, now pirate captain & his crew. Engage in exhilarating combat on land and sea in the hunt for lost memories and treasure.

3353520.description: Dungeons Deep is a non-linear dungeon crawler set in a dark fantasy world. In this demo you'll experience one of the the early levels in the game, with some higher tier items and enemies added for you to try out.

3354060.description: Detective novelist MEL Gideon, whose career is facing difficulties, receives a strange letter claiming someone is in trouble and needs her help. Intrigued, she decides to investigate. As she digs deeper, she starts to realize that her past is far more complicated than she ever imagined...

3354780.description: The Scouring is an RTS with fast pace, high attention to detail and next generation experience. Lead humans or orcs in a Classic Mode or use one of powerful Heroes to fight for victory! Play alone or with friends. Use our modding tools to create maps and custom game modes! Join The Scouring Demo!

videos.nom: Heroes trying to settle their argument

3356650.description: Slip 'n slide around this casual puzzle adventure! Be a cute slime and explore a magical world. Only stop sliding when you run into something -- SPLAT! Perfect to pick up 'n play for a minute or binge in a weekend.

3361010.description: Take charge of your very own fast-food restaurant in this demo version of the game! Experience the thrill of running a fast-food business, from purchasing cooking equipment to preparing meals and serving hungry customers.

3363670.description: In Shard Squad, join elemental creatures to save their lands in intense battles against challenging hordes and bosses. Strengthen yourself with unique allies, gather valuable items, face epic calamities, and unlock new members to create unique strategies on your path to victory!

3363690.description: Phantom Squad is an intense 1-4 player tactical top-down shooter that blends fast-paced combat with real-time strategy.

3365740.description: Journey the sorrowful spirit world in soulslike deck builder, Death Howl. Craft cards and claim powerful totems to defeat the woeful spirits lurking in the mystical lands. Unravel the tale of a grieving mother in her desperate attempt to defy death and bring back her son.

3366020.description: Liminal Shift is a unique atmospheric suspense game developed using the latest Unreal Engine 5 technologies such as Lumen and Nanite. With every step you take, Liminal Shift pushes you deeper into an eerie, unsettling experience like no other.

3366110.description: Solo Challenging Raid Bosses, Your Way! Craft your perfect build to master intense multi-phase raidboss encounters in this exciting ARPG. Deep customization with 9 specializations, 100s of items, skills and more. No Group, No Queue, All Boss Raids!

3366180.description: Take your first step into the endless struggle with this demo! Experience the story of a family fighting to escape an infinite loop. In this roguelite action game, combine unique skills and relics to create powerful synergies. Defeat the loop’s guardians and break free from this relentless cycle.

3367180.description: HitTube is a horror streamer shooter. The zombie apocalypse is here and now you're a streamer who kills live for donations. Your weapon is a minigun and your minigun is your best friend!

3374930.description: A classic text adventure - but you're not the one playing it. You're the game master for an idiot player named STEVE. Parse the player's enigmatic commands and decide how NPCs react to him. Who knew that running an RPG would be so frustrating?

3375100.description: DuneCrawl is an online coop action-adventure game where players take on the roles of desert faring privateers. Together, players explore the dust seas by piloting their Dune Crawler, a gigantic walking crustacean festooned with cannons and treasure maps.

3381200.description: Plunge into a living nightmare where every roll counts. Chain fluid combat with dice-fueled attacks, stack relics into ferocious synergies, and build unstoppable momentum. Slash through fate, bend chance to your will, and defeat the Black Die in this board-game inspired roguelite dungeon crawler.

3399490.description: “The Unreachable Oneiroborder” is a beginner-friendly Touhou-styled Bullet Hell shmup. Indulge in a uniquely Touhou experience with intricate patterns and stylish effects.

3400850.description: The demo for our strategy game with a new kind of enemy. Calyx puts you in charge of a space mining outpost, locked in battle against powerful plant-aliens. Build your base, gather resources, assemble your forces, and take on the Calyx. With only an out-of-date AI for company, can you survive?

3403460.description: Fight your way through the endless horde of robots! Control powerful mechs armed with a large variety of weapons, including: lasers, cluster bombs, and rocket launchers. Complete high-stakes missions, upgrade your arsenal, and climb the tech tree to save the world from the attacking automatons!

3406030.description: Swan Song is a cozy puzzle game that invites you to slow down, listen, and reflect. Set inside a magical music box, each puzzle asks players to place notes on a musical scale. When you turn the key, the composition plays, activating platforms and opening paths that guide a small swan to safety.

3408840.description: Shoot paint, mix colors, and solve puzzles in this adventure about friendship and redemption. Just don't enter that portal to another universe, and ᴇᴠᴇʀʏTʜɪɴɢ will 𝐛𝐞 ᴘEʀ𝐅𝓔ᴄᴛʟʏ 𝒇 𝔦 𝓃 ҽ . • °

3409750.description: A relaxing roguelike deckbuilder where you construct equations with your cards. Craft your strategy, build your deck, draw cards and create equations to produce points. Climb the leaderboards with your high score in multiple different game modes, or simply click, relax and watch big numbers go up.

3410010.description: Recruit a wild roster of warriors and command your mercenaries on a chaotic tabletop battlefield. With infinite builds, brutal choices, and endless replayability, Tabletop Tavern is an RTS built for roguelike fanatics.

3411220.description: Dreadline Express is a 1st-person, psychological horror metroidbrainia set aboard the last human train. Unravel mysteries of the enigmatic train, face strange passengers, and shape your path using a unique card-based mechanic that gives you full narrative control. This is no longer our world.

3413480.description: Play the demo version and get a taste of the thrill! Discover a gold mine in the used car market! Hunt for bargains, buy cheap, repair, and sell high. Your journey from zero to car mogul awaits. How quickly will you find your way in this lucrative venture?

videos.nom: Car Dealer Simulator - Release Date Trailer
Car Dealer Simulator Free Demo - Release Date Trailer

3420970.description: In this Online 2 player co-op puzzle adventure game, you and a friend become Inkwellers - story dwellers diving into Celiphia’s journal. Solve puzzles, explore forgotten memories, and uncover the truth behind her mysterious disappearance.

3422670.description: Flowerbots is an incremental game you can play in active or idle modes. Upgrade bots. Balance harvesting and planting. Explore synergies. Crush anomalies. And watch your plan unfold as the numbers go up.

3425900.description: 烽火恋佳人，这一次，故事的格局不再局限于二人世界。乱世烽烟中，家国大义与赤诚纯爱如蛛网般缠绕，每一次选择都可能让历史的齿轮转向截然不同的轨道。我们埋下了数十条隐藏线索与叙事，真相或许残酷，但每一份“意难平”背后，都将是你亲手写下的、独一无二的史诗。

3429540.description: Piece by Piece is a literal puzzle platformer where each level is fragmented into puzzle pieces. Clear each puzzle by connecting and unconnected each piece to make your way through each of our 13 handcrafted levels in our demo. Discover new themes and mechanics along the way!

3442130.description: Tactical team-building roguelike auto-battler with active and passive playstyles. Draft a team as you explore maps full of monsters, build synergies, equip items and cast spells to support your team during battles and help them escape the Underboard.

3442630.description: "Back to the same planet, together... That's all I wanted..." BOKURA: planet is a two-player puzzle adventure that explores cooperative gaming. Players take on the role of the crew on a space exploration ship as they try to escape from a planet where they have crash-landed on.

3447260.description: A turn-based horror RPG with retro 32-bit 3D graphics. Survive the horrors of the mansion that changes every time you enter.

3450020.description: Run a shop in the zombie apocalypse! Trade batteries, craft stock, manage your staff, and fend off undead hordes. Will you be a hero, or profit at any cost? Your choices shape your store - and your fate.

3450230.description: Earth has fallen. Science and the Occult have united forces to brace for the arrival of the Eldritch. But will the efforts against this strange, alien race be enough? Play as one of many Proximae used to help defend humanity in this turn-based, roguelike, intergalactic deck builder.

3451610.description: Fill your quota or die. Please note: This is the original prototype for the full Coal LLC game. You may encounter bugs and performance issues that are not in the full game.

3452510.description: A charming picture-book style interactive story with light puzzles and turn-based combat. After the Pharmacist’s knowledge vanishes, experiment on your partner to learn! Analyze potion effects to deduce ingredient properties. Enjoy vibrant art and story. Reclaim your lost knowledge!

3453320.description: Live your best squirrel life. Explore, gather, craft, and build incredible treehouses in acres of beautiful parkland. Scurry across lawns, up trees, and leap limb to limb solo (or co-op in the full game). Endless summer days of adventure await.

3453690.description: Build your own diecast store! Unbox surprise car packs, expand your collection, and join thrilling races on racing tracks. A world of speed and excitement awaits in your store!

3455150.description: Take control of the demon sisters Kirika and Masha as they attempt to revive their Demon Lord Maxim and rebuild their castle in this 2D action Metroidvania adventure!

videos.nom: Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark Demo 2st PV EN

3456560.description: Embark on a galactic journey in Cubic Odyssey, an open-world adventure where you explore vibrant planets, craft tools, build vehicles, and fight the Red Darkness. Uncover ancient mysteries, and shape a universe full of life, danger, and limitless possibilities!

3456690.description: Hear me, mortals, for I shall reveal to you the path to true power - a demonic fusion of deckbuilding, ritual duels, and roguelite! I speak of a realm shrouded in darkness, where only the most wicked may thrive. Behold my demo masterpiece, "Just A Shadow Game"

3457160.description: Welcome to the Radiolight demo! A child disappears without a trace. A local policeman is drawn into a national park, seeking the truth. Mysterious radio signals beckon him further and further. Investigate, survive and face the unknown in Radiolight— an '80s thriller by solo dev Krystof Knesl.

3461940.description: Abra-Cooking-Dabra is a cooking card game. Manage ingredients and make British dishes to keep toves, borogoves, and mome raths fed. Meet timers and fulfill puzzling orders despite the angry wacky Cat being your boss. You are Wonderland's new chef.

3462550.description: Locomoto is a cosy, life-sim adventure game set on a train, where you are the conductor! Customise and manage your train, while tending to your colourful passengers. Get onboard and embark on a journey through beautiful landscapes, accompanied by a soft, lofi original soundtrack.

3463790.description: Escape from a mysterious underground megastructure in this short atmospheric 3D platformer.

3464890.description: 300+ lifelike bugs to collect and grow—breed them to unlock rare species! Customize your terrarium with 300+ landscaping items and 70+ backgrounds. A tiny, soothing nature escape on your screen!🦋🐌🦗🐝🐞🐛🦐

videos.nom: 《虫虫生态箱》正式版现已发售

3465000.description: Build, automate, & optimize elegant production lines, in a factory made from modules you create. Whether you’re solving intricate logistics puzzles or designing aesthetically pleasing factories, Modulus is built for creative expression. Your solutions, like your factories, are uniquely your own.

3466550.description: Mine, Refine and Sell Gemstones of various rarities to eagerly awaiting customers in this brief demo of Gemporium, a mining simulation management game. Manage your time and personal finances as you play through 10 days in the life of an anxious mole starting a Gem Emporium!

3468410.description: It's time to open shop! Inherit your family's repair shop, and roll up your sleeves. Fix up the prized possessions of the forest folk, paint yourself a masterpiece to sell and make your family shop all your own with decorations, furniture and cookies!

videos.nom: Piece By Piece Date Announcement Trailer

3472400.description: A grotesque illness binds the town of Flint Peak. Several survivors try to escape with their lives as mysterious creatures roam the streets. Face horrific monsters, solve puzzles and uncover the truth in this classic survival horror. Can you escape the nightmare?

3472810.description: Make weapons, make money. A small glimpse into the full game. Includes 3 different weapons to make, dozens of upgrades to research, a taste of the Prestige system, and the ability to fully automate weapons production.

3473530.description: BloomTale is a cozy flower shop simulation game where creativity meets management. Arrange beautiful flower compositions, manage your shop, and satisfy your customers in a magical world of blooming potential.

3475100.description: Command an ancient starship and fight your way to the heart of a dying Empire. Fend off attacks from demented cultists, craven space pirates, and xenophobic Imperial soldiers. Discover powerful artifacts and use them to build your ship into a fearsome war engine.

3476420.description: Ringash is a boss-focused ARPG featuring fast-paced combat, stylish combos and meaningful exploration. As a warrior with mystical powers, you’ll try to save a world that’s being destroyed. Seek and challenge the bosses to grow your strength. Explore and uncover the truth to shape your story.

3477260.description: Explore the beginning area of this open world, expressive 3D platformer adventure! Meet the cast, find some juicy gear and compete with other players online!

3478820.description: Wordatro! fuses addictive word game with thrilling roguelite strategy! Spell high-scoring words, chain massive combos, and unlock game-changing bonuses. With 25+ unique upgrades and daily challenges, endless linguistic adventures await!

3479320.description: Embark on a relaxing yet challenging journey to manage your own supermarket. Grow organic crops, care for your animals, and sell products to your customers. Build and expand your shelves. Can you transform your supermarket into an empire?

3490390.description: Explore and mine fully destructible worlds. Automate increasingly complex production chains. Delve deep to uncover an ancient civilization’s powerful secrets and learn to love the sand in this factory game where every pixel is a valuable resource.

3490810.description: "Rana Card" is a roguelite card game where you manage a farm, complete KPI for the Frog.Draw cards in exciting, tense moments, you’ll navigate or exploit time explosion, earn packs and chests, build your deck, and play cards to earn gold.Face strategic choices, disasters, cataclysm along the way.

3491390.description: Lovecraft meets Papers, Please. Play as a lighthouse keeper and guide ships safely into the harbor using your radio. Survive the presence of something impossible, and don’t let the shadows consume you!

3493310.description: Embark on a thrilling journey in a high-stakes, turn-based tactics game. Lead an elite squad in a fictional, dystopian Eastern Europe as you unravel a sinister conspiracy threatening the nation. Navigate intense strategic battles and adapt to ever-evolving challenges to prevail.

3496630.description: Join Maliki and her wacky family in their epic battle against Poison, a fearsome plant creature that has colonized space-time. Go along on a fantastic odyssey through the ages that provides a unique mix of exploration, temporal riddles and turn-based fights full of surprises.

videos.nom: Maliki : Poison Of The Past Gameplay Trailer

3497720.description: Have you ever tried to roll 1,000,000 on a set of dice? No? Build the right bag of die, and you might just pull it off.

3499510.description: House of Horror: Outside is better DEMO" is a first-person psychological horror videogame demo that offers an immersive and terrifying experience. With the help of your wits, and a dynamo flashlight, explore the facilities of the house of horror, solve puzzles, and try to get out of it alive.

3500550.description: When the world is coming to an end, who would you want to speak to one last time? Schrödinger’s Call is a visual novel that lets you experience the pain and salvation of human connection, as if you were turning the pages of a picture book.

3506690.description: Golden Swirl is a dark fantasy, semi-real-time action deckbuilder. Master tactical movement to dodge fierce attacks while managing your hand. Fully voiced with custom heroes, fine-tune your deck, relics, and runes to repel the Swirl. Can you survive the madness?

3508630.description: Welcome to ISLANDERS: New Shores. Build your island retreat in a calm, minimalist world with exciting new features that keep the classic charm while inspiring fresh creativity.

3510080.description: Stranded in the year 10,000, Kent—an average Joe turned clone—must survive, explore, and rebuild civilization with the help of a snarky AI. Craft, farm, and automate in this 2D craftervania adventure as you uncover Earth’s secrets and kickstart humanity, one machine at a time.

3511700.description: Tank controls. Fixed cameras. Pure Terror. Set in a haunting world of twisted experiments and occult nightmares, this game brings back the survival horror mechanics you know and love while pushing the genre into terrifying new depths.

3512680.description: Astro Prospector Prologue is an incremental bullet hell about mining cofferoids and fighting SpaceCorp. Collect resources, upgrade your ship and become unstoppable. Return AstroCoffee to humanity!

3518690.description: This demo is the first area of Cold Abyss , featuring a short tutorial and the first area of the game.

3520250.description: MR DONALD — the game of the decade. You’re the hero, the hope of gamers and the entire world. Defeat every enemy with your partner and make gamedev great again!

3524830.description: A Horde Survival Game set in a fantasy world with ARPG-like controls featuring active abilities and loot progression.

3525010.description: Step into the shoes of a 40-year-old finally ready to leave the nest in this hilarious RPG-Life Simulation mix. Tackle wacky challenges, embrace absurd adventures, and prove that you can start fresh at any age with determination (and a bit of chaos).

3525720.description: A girl who has practiced martial arts since childhood finds herself, for some unknown reason, trapped in a fantastical world. She must continuously fight to find her way back home! This is a high-difficulty action game featuring intense combat, immersive scene atmospheres, highly oppressive NPCs.

3526400.description: Every why has a wherefore. You are trapped, and you must escape. But is that really the goal? Centum is an unreliable narrative-driven adventure where everything may be a lie.

3527370.description: A cozy management sim where the jazz is smooth, the cocktails are cooler than the evening breeze, and the lake reflects your perfect escape.

3548820.description: The Hotel Galactic Demo combines cozy management with a heartfelt story. Help Gustav and Maklo run the hotel amidst the lively chaos of nightly guest arrivals. Expand the building, craft furniture, and tend to your backyard farm while meeting travelers from all across the galaxy.

3559900.description: Hatch, evolve, and upgrade powerful space creatures in this action-packed sci-fi 3rd person shooter that reinvents the monster taming genre!

3567300.description: "CORPSE CARNIVAL" is a top-down action-adventure game where you will play as Li Xiaomeng, a first-year student at the "Linge" Military Academy, and escape from a city filled with zombies and monsters alongside "Asami Yuki."

3572950.description: Recruit mercenaries, combine their traits, and forge endless synergies. Venture through the mysterious medieval realm, facing powerful foes and mighty bosses. Simple turn-based rules hide deep strategic depth—build your ultimate team, master the pieces, and uncover the secrets of the Black fog.

3579260.description: [Grill'd] is a dinner party detective game played from the first-person perspective of a royal investigator. Trapped in a mansion located in the estate of a fallen aristocrat, collect clues about the cases, connect them to one another, and interrogate the suspect to uncover the truth.

3581860.description: A 2D platformer Metroidvania with deep movement and no jump button. Upgrade your umbrella to explore an abandoned planet and ascend to the moon.

3587740.description: Woodo feels like a 3D coloring book you can touch, a relaxing tale told through handcrafted wooden dioramas. No pressure, just a cozy world that remembers what it felt like to be a child.

3590810.description: The deckbuilding roguelike with no energy – play cards using physical space! Slot cards together, manipulate the shape of your cards, and create overpowered combos to break the game!

3593730.description: A 3D marble rolling game where you're chained to your friends!

3599520.description: Fend off attacks from all directions in this roguelite strategy-deck builder. Battle foes in grid-based combat, collect unique cards to build powerful synergies, and make tough decisions during strange encounters as you restore the corrupted land.

videos.nom: Journey to the Void - Gameplay Announce Trailer

3602770.description: The Shroom and Gloom demo drops you into a weird and moody double-deckbuilding roguelike. Build two distinct decks, battle through 26 handcrafted tunnels, and face off against spore-swarming enemies and biome bosses.

3606110.description: Coffee Talk Tokyo is the newest entry in the beloved series, set in a late-night café in Tokyo. Brew drinks, meet humans and yōkai, and experience heartfelt stories in a cozy, story-rich world.

3609300.description: Steel Century Groove is a rhythm-RPG where you pilot mecha in dance battles! In the demo, try out the deep music combat system, build a team of colossal dancers, make friends, and challenge rivals as you take your first steps on the journey from small-town pilot to big-city champion.

3609770.description: Become a parliamentarian, create a powerful party, and lead it to victory in this humorous RPG. Manage your popularity and dignity, use unique powers, and navigate a storyline inspired by current events.

3610160.description: Immersive survival-adventure. Wake up in deep space with no memory, amid debris and dangerous 5D fractals of an alien world. Piece together the catastrophe, build a base, drive vehicles, laser-cut asteroids, fight for life and remember who you are among these secrets.

3616300.description: AM is a high-speed horror game that keeps you on the edge of your seat—and your foot on the gas—as you race to leave the nightmares of an abandoned world in your rearview.

3622980.description: Reap the whirlwind. In this demo for Grim Trials—a roguelite dungeon crawler—hone your scythe skills and refine your equipment with every run until nothing can stop your rise as a Grim Reaper!

3623320.description: A "Blind" simulator that lets you experience a new perspective and immersive sensory journey. Step into a world of darkness using your guide cane.

3626070.description: Take on the roles of expendable volunteers sent to a forsaken facility on a remote Japanese island. Recover lost data, scavenge for resources, manage your inventory, and endure unspeakable cosmic horrors. In this top-down extraction survival horror, every expedition is a journey back from madness.

3628930.description: Defend the embers of hope in this roguelike strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Recruit and command workers to gather resources, build your camp and set up your defenses during the day. When night falls, fend off waves of deadly creatures with powerful, upgradable weapons.

3629010.description: Become the custodian of a store dealing in occult antiquities. Explore the quaint and gloomy town of Undermere, where strange goings-on and dark mysteries abound. Find and identify arcane artefacts, use your collection to aid the townsfolk with their unusual problems — and remember to pet your cat!

3629520.description: Relive the epic battles between Spartans, Persians, and Egyptians in Ancient Wars: Sparta HD. Enjoy HD graphics, asymmetric civilizations, enhanced campaigns, new maps, smarter AI, and a revamped multiplayer mode. Forge your empire, master warfare, and make history in the Ancient World!

3630390.description: Turn trash into cash in a dystopian world! Fill Up The Hole is a short incremental game where you build a city, automate garbage production, and toss it into a magical hole for profit.

3634260.description: A modern-day horror RPG with tactical combat and survival horror roots. Customize your loadout, manage limited resources, and exploit enemy weaknesses in tense, strategic encounters.

3636220.description: PengPong is a single-player survivor-like shooter where you play as a penguin with a hockey stick who bounces everything in sight. Inspired by 1940s–60s American amusement culture, it features chaotic pinball-style combat and vintage cartoon monsters in a unique survival showdown.

3638700.description: Play inKONBINI: Prologue Demo! Step into Makoto’s shoes as she begins her work behind the counter at the Honki-Ponki konbini. Meet your first customer, ease into the quiet rhythm of the small-town store, and start to uncover the stories it holds.

3639350.description: Shan Hai: Myth Origins Demo is a MOBA-style action roguelike inspired by the Shanhaijing. Forge divine weapons, master the Five Elements, collect artifacts, bind spirits, capture beasts. Play solo or up to 4-player co-op.

3639920.description: Gather magical dice, adapt your gear and venture through a land haunted by folklore creatures.

3640210.description: Thank you for your application. After 15 rounds of interviews, you do not match our requirements for the position. You are transferred as a Junior Interviewer to review the candidate's resume according to the company's requirements and send appropriate thanks letters.

3641260.description: Set in the depths of the Red Seas, Magnavis is a 1-4 player co-op submarine horror survival game. Manually operate grotesque ship systems powered by living organs, weld catastrophic leaks, and survive with your crew in an abyss where unknown terrors lurk in the absolute dark.

3642880.description: Try the demo of a renovation game set in a 1990s Polish apartment block. Take on jobs, cut costs, improvise, and see if you have a talent for questionable workmanship. The full version will offer more tasks, tools, and absurd renovation chaos.

3647930.description: Prepare to suffer! Souls-like combat adventure in a unique world. Learn to fight... then fight to realize your belief.A warrior gradually grows and uncovers the ultimate truth of world change.

3648570.description: Klostyn is a sci-fi shooter that stays true to the late-'90s FPS style. The protagonist fights alien creatures and space pirates on a distant planet.

3649520.description: A sandbox adventure where every pixel is physically and chemically simulated! Build intricate, fully functional machines from the pixels around you. Harvest, react, and manipulate all 118 elements to craft everything from simple tools to complex systems.

3650480.description: You, an ordinary youth, accidentally travel to a parallel Three Kingdoms era. By fate, you encounter famous historical generals and beauties. Faced with emotional and historical choices, will you retire in the mountains with a beauty, or lead generals into battle?

videos.nom: Dive in now and unlock this unconventional Three Kingdoms FMV! The Three Kingdoms: Rebirth is now available!
No Need for $17 — Forge Your Three Kingdoms Legacy! 丨 Pricing for The Three Kingdoms: Rebirth Revealed

3651330.description: Travel back to 16th-century France and delve into the mysterious depths of a seemingly abandoned alchemist's tower. Do you dare brave the horrors that beckon you below... deeper still?

3651790.description: Get a taste of BALL x PIT, a brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite. Batter hordes of enemies with ricocheting balls and gather the riches of the pit to expand your homestead, generate resources and recruit unique heroes in this hair-raising demo.

3653800.description: Build an idyllic 19th century Mediterranean town and help it flourish into a prosperous city. Freely place and customise each element to create the perfect home for your growing population in this cozy city builder from the creators of Station to Station.

3674060.description: Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter. Manage a dysfunctional team of misfit heroes and strategize who to send to emergencies around the city, all while balancing office politics, personal relationships, and your own quest to become a hero.

3676860.description: Can you rebuild civilisation after a zombie apocalypse? From the creator of Plague Inc. comes a unique blend of strategic simulation, survival city builder and ‘mini 4X’. Build settlements, harvest resources and shape society as you lead Humanity out of the darkness.

3682970.description: A dreamy Alice in Wonderland-inspired RPG that follows 19-year-old Alice as she tries to escape the surreal, cozy hellscape that is Wonderland—hopefully with her sanity intact.

3702990.description: Escape from a flat 2D TV screen and discover a 3D world in this story-driven puzzle game! Embark on a journey between dimensions, walk across the neon city, through the screens full of unexpected puzzles.

3706490.description: A roguelike memory deckbuilder where you bend the rules of card matching with wild combos, strategy-defining items and cards featuring some personality-packed cats.

3713400.description: Become the last conductor and rule over the final train society in a frozen world. Gather, expand, and forge your train while building powerful synergies with mighty artifacts. Your position—and the safety of your passengers—now rests in your hands.

3713890.description: A hard immersive sim set in a dystopian and nihilistic world. To complete each level, start with a plan by choosing weapons, paths and abilities. Die. Find a better plan. Die again. Repeat until you finish the level. Then replay the levels to find new creative ways to beat them. Co-op mode included.

3717520.description: It's 1972 on Furikyu Island, and you're just getting started. A jazz-hop record spins up. Your deranged mentor lights his cigarette. Slash every enemy before it burns out. One-hit-kills, no mistakes... well, maybe a few.

3721600.description: FIGHT! COOK! SERVE! Get a first taste of Monster Chef in this action RPG demo with roguelite and simulation elements. As Pranzo, a tiny chef-warrior, cook monsters on the battlefield, explore Delizia’s first biome, rebuild your inn, and begin your rise through the ancient Monster Chef Order.

3726690.description: First-person adventure game. Use your magical abilities to solve puzzles or navigate through areas! Explore, use items, brew potions and unlock your full alchemical potential. Are you willing to do what it takes to claim a soul of your own?

3728950.description: Star Overdrive is a high-speed action-adventure set in an open world. Race across an alien planet on your Hoverboard, mastering tricks, battling enemies, solving puzzles, and using your powers to overcome challenges and shape your destiny!

3729720.description: Bloodgrounds merges tactical turn-based combat with strategic management layers and includes RPG and roguelite elements. Forged in the pits of the arena, you fought your way out and now as a wealthy patron you recruit, train, and command your team of hardened Gladiators to glory - or death.

3729870.description: Transform your childhood home as you build brilliant factories and forge lifelong friendships, then reach for the skies and finally finish your family's dream - your mother's precious rocket ship. Roll up your sleeves, it turns out that saving this town really IS rocket science!

3732880.description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in this roguelite colony-sim strategy game. Command your Landship in tactical battles, care for a crew composed of all sorts of characters, shape your home, manage resources, and lead expeditions into the March. Discover what lies at its heart... and in yours.

videos.nom: Trailblazers Into the March - Official Demo Trailer

3738000.description: You are trapped in a small house with psychosis, having lost your memory. Carefully observe your surroundings, distinguish between reality and hallucinations, and take the medication provided by visitors on time to overcome your illness.

3743400.description: The rowdy adventures of drunk-as-a-skunk Rogue Lita and Vampire of Demise Endo! Stagger around traps and stumble through demon assaults. Make your way to the dungeon's deepest depths—rumored to contain the most precious of booze!

3743450.description: Toy mayhem unleashed! Arrange, combine, and craft the wildest toy army inside your desk, then crash into chaotic cartoon brawls across the tabletop!

3746840.description: You wake up with an explosive headache in a pool of your own blood. You're Exit, a terrible woman whose awful past has finally caught up to her. Fulfill contracts for the people who drilled into your skull — guns-blazing, slow and tactical — it doesn’t matter. They know you’ll do whatever it takes.

3747250.description: Gamblers Table is an automation game where you toss coins to earn money. Buy bigger and better coins, unlock upgrades and hire little helpers to automate the process and take care of all the busy flipping work for you. Simple. Satisfying. Strangely compelling...

3750130.description: Tame, collect, fight! Assemble an unstoppable team of unique Montabi in this Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder. Master their awesome abilities, synergize their strategic strengths and save the city in tactical turn-based combat!

3752730.description: "Create the games you want, at the time you want, and live doing only what you love." In this realistic life simulation game, an independent game developer dreams of such a life, struggling with money and time while paying taxes until death. Whether this life is happy or truly lonely, you decide.

3754660.description: "Imagine Future" is a Visual Novel with a campus theme. You will follow the perspective of the protagonist Ji Wang, experience the life of a high school student. The final examination seemed so far away. one day, it was close at hand. Standing at the crossroads of life, what choice will you make?

3758120.description: Holo's Hanafuda is a banter-filled card game battler fully voiced by and featuring hololive talent! Join Nakiri Ayame, Shirakami Fubuki, Ookami Mio, and Sakura Miko on a wild adventure through a strange land filled with card games and chaos.

3762600.description: Walking and Swimming Simulator. No monsters. Explore liminal spaces where each level reflects different aspects of your mind. Savor the atmosphere and let your feelings guide you. Relax or feel anxious as you dive underwater. Overcome your fears in uncanny, unnerving, and eerie spaces.

3763830.description: Martial arts meets music video in Dead as Disco, a neon-drenched Beat ‘Em Up where every punch, kick, and combo syncs to the music. Join Charlie Disco on a quest to confront the villainous Idols and reunite the band.

3769110.description: A retro adventure inspired by 90's adventure games and Arabian Nights. Explore dungeons, solve puzzles, and collect awesome treasures

videos.nom: Azaran: Islands of the Jinn Demo Trailer

3773470.description: Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told, letting him see, move, and interact, but he can forget! Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity and manage conflicting beliefs to solve cute mind-bending challenges.

videos.nom: LAGS - Summer Game Fest 2026 Extended Trailer

3776480.description: In a fractured world of colliding planes, wield your reality-bending abilities to lead Earth's remnants against cosmic threats. Develop your task force. Explore unknown territories. Manipulate space and minds ingeniously to reignite hope for humanity in this new strategic RPG.

3777250.description: Liminal cosmic horror - you'll wander in an abandoned amusement park, walk along empty tunnels and crawl through narrow corridors. Join a ride and step into the dark. Explore eerie remains of a world that shouldn't exist. Find clues and discover the truth.

3777540.description: Lead a band of mercenaries through battle after battle in this Sci-Fi, turn-based RPG. Fight your way across different planets, earning loot and equipment to outfit your team – and remember, no option is off the table when survival is on the line.

3781820.description: Outhold is a short, strategic incremental game that blends tower defense with a deep meta-progression. Experiment with builds and find overpowered synergies to defend the dwindling fires of Outhold.

3783770.description: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

3785330.description: Blast. Collect. Upgrade. Repeat. Void Miner is a retro-inspired roguelite asteroid shooter where you pilot a space ship and manage an automated tower to destroy endless fields of chaos. Dodge, blast, and harvest your way through waves of asteroids in a fast-paced loop of destruction and progression.

3785530.description: Leap Galaxy is a 2D platformer with a minimalistic aesthetic and gameplay that puts speed and flow first. Take advantage of momentum and master the recoil of your shots to reach insane speeds and beat each level as fast as possible!

3787600.description: Bullet Ballet is a Wild West action FPS game that follows John Maxwell Goldman, a man searching for answers and his missing father. Set in the unforgiving frontier, this comic book-inspired journey places the fate of a father and son in the hands of the Wild West.

3788960.description: Build your weapon to its full potential in Galactic Vault, a fast-paced FPS roguelite. Discover endless upgrade combinations, craft diverse builds, and unleash devastating abilities. Get ready to infiltrate high-security vaults and recover lost tech.

3793150.description: Explore a mysterious island archipelago as a tiny gecko. Complete ancient puzzles, effortlessly climb cliffs, and eat bugs as you make your way across an island civilization lost to time.

3796720.description: A surreal corporate horror deckbuilder where you gamble your life for cash, dodge murderous JERRY cards, and “maximise synergies” to climb the company ladder in Mr Magpie’s office nightmare.

3796930.description: In the thrilling conclusion of the Amanda the Adventurer trilogy, follow Riley as they uncover the ultimate secrets behind Amanda, Hameln, and mysteries that have plagued Kensdale for decades.

3799500.description: Burn With Me is a story-centric deckbuilder filled with cozy dread and occultic mysteries. In order to summon a Personal Demon you'll master inventive gameplay with position-based synergies, and permanently burn your cards and your soul.

3802540.description: Stop The F is a first-person puzzle game made in the style of old games. Use a camera capable of capturing objects from reality into subspace and bringing them back.

3803790.description: Rhythm Hotel is a rhythm game where history's most famous figures check in, and all hell breaks loose. bursting with wildly unpredictable, absurdly hilarious storylines. No skill barriers, no finger-melting difficulty: simple controls, catchy beats, and pure foot-tapping chaos.

3805810.description: An esotreric horror puzzle adventure, where your thoughts and mood affect the environment around you.

3807090.description: You accidentally grew a mushroom girl! Overcome your social anxiety to help her live her brief life to the fullest! Or… don't ;)

3807830.description: Explore the mystical Sanctuary of the Old Well and reconnect with your childhood friends while solving environmental puzzles. Meet quirky animals, unravel forgotten tales and immerse yourself in an interactive soundscape as you piece together your place in the world.

3810040.description: Turnbound is an auto battler, where you manage a hero's inventory to escape a haunted boardgame. Each run is different from the last, with unique upgrades, combos and synergies. Async PvP lets you battle the ghosts of other players at your own pace in this unique new inventory battler.

3810460.description: Ultimate Theater Simulator is a first-person cinema management game where you screen movies, serve snacks, hire staff, handle chaos, and grow your dream theater from the ground up.

3819690.description: Nox Mortalis is a retro-style open world survival game where you must gather resources, craft essential gear, and explore sinister dungeons. Face hellish creatures and fight to survive in this world.

3820720.description: Wasteland Bites is a horror-based food truck sim. Cooking up questionable cuisine in your post-apocalyptic food truck is tough. Fending off mutants, UFOs, rabid dogs, and things lurking in the dark? That's the real challenge. A chaotic mix of cooking and survival in a long gone world.

3821560.description: A survival-crafting colony sim set in a flooded world of unstable islands. Build your colony, scavenge debris, craft equipment, and train your survivors. Construct a raft and fend off sharks as you explore island bunkers and uncover lost Float-Tech from an old-world corporation.

3821770.description: Fish, scale, sell, repeat. Scale the Depths is a casual fishing game built around this simple but satisfying loop. Feed hungry customers, upgrade your gear, and uncover the many secrets hidden beneath the surface.

3826220.description: This demo of Tia:weird hunter features Chapter One of the full experience. Dive into a hand-drawn 2D world, unleash fast, fluid combos, and take on fierce boss battles that will test your skills. Explore the mysterious "Faceless City" and get a taste of the story, combat, and chaos still to come.

3828820.description: Now available in bite-sized demo form! Don’t Stop, Girlypop! is a Y2K arena movement shooter where standing still is not an option. ❤ Just ❤ Don’t ❤ Stop ❤ Moving! ❤

3833670.description: Craft limitless spells! Destroy hordes of enemies and duel other master wizards!

3833720.description: Create unique spells by combining magical runes to solve puzzles your way. Transform objects, manipulate time, and discover the mysteries of a world where everyone has vanished, leaving only 12 people behind. Every puzzle has multiple solutions - if you can imagine it, you can probably do it.

3837060.description: Rita is a cozy adventure where a little chicklet solves word-based puzzles to transform the world around her. Follow her story across generations, meet her grandchicklet, and be a part of her legacy.

3837840.description: Drill Bird is a cozy-yet-tense digging platformer where every trip underground counts. Play as a bird fallen from the sky, in search for powerful ores to hatch your Egg. Get home before night falls, upgrade abilities, grow stronger, and unfold a sincere bird story about survival, care and purpose.

3840060.description: Welcome Tavernkeep! In this demo of our D&D-inspired visual novel you will run a cozy seaside tavern, meet adventurers, gather rumours and mix fate-altering drinks to stop dreams from twisting into nightmares.

3843030.description: Your uncle’s once-thriving jewelry shop is crumbling, and it’s your job to bring it back to life! Mine precious ore, smelt it into shiny jewelry, add rare gemstones and sell to every customer who walks in. Mine by day, sell by night, solo or in co-op, and become a successful merchant!

3843480.description: Touhou Crafts of the Lucky Beasts is a fanmade strategy card game based on Touhou Project. Utilize the power of the four seasons and battle as a colorful cast of young girls! Overcome your opponent and unearth the secrets beneath the Card Duel incident!

3850990.description: 687 Days on Mars is a survival game where you are stranded alone on Mars - your task is to manage resources, build a base from scratch, grow food, and explore the red planet in search of supplies and other hidden challenges. Every breath and decision counts - can you survive on the Red Planet?

3853080.description: Hack, slash, and cast your way through a haunted kingdom brimming with secrets where no two builds are ever the same. As a cursed mage-knight you will unlock devastating spells, equip ability transforming runes, and reforge your curse on the path to victory or death in this fantasy action roguelite.

3854250.description: Animas Prologue is a standalone chapter in the Animas story, allowing you to explore the Blanco family home for the first time and begin to uncover its dark secrets.

3858070.description: Buster Jam is a playable cartoon, focused on fast-paced mini-game action. Explore jam-packed worlds and survive an onslaught of wild animated boss-fights. Its lively style and soundtrack hold inspiration from the '90s and early 2000s, with a splash of its own modern flair.

3858730.description: Build a sprawling pirate haven, raise a fleet to explore the high seas, and take on the Crown to keep the Age of Piracy alive! From ale to flintlock pistols, and from scallywags to swashbucklers, you’ll need to manage complex production chains and govern a rowdy crew to reign supreme over the seas!

3860660.description: A solo-developed Tower Defense hybrid with FPS and RTS combat. Build turrets, mine resources, and fight back AI swarms. Includes tutorial, campaign level, Test Range, and demo-exclusive modes with Steam leaderboards. Strategize, Build, Defend.

3861240.description: Perform life-saving operations in this fast-paced surgery sim. As lizard surgeon Dr. Peri Maddock, you'll treat injuries, excise tumors, and hack corporate organs with surgical precision. The patient's life is in your claws!

3871460.description: ✉️ Become a living letter and find your way to the one who still waits for you! Fly, sail, roll, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and travel through time and continents!😸

3876140.description: SUPERPANEL is a hardcore tactical shooter with high lethality for solo players or groups of friends. Customize your gear and squads, take on dangerous missions through urban labyrinths, and fight your way to the heart of Megaslavia. Enemies are both humans and monsters.

3876150.description: In a hand-drawn black and white dungeon crawler RPG inspired by classic D&D of the 80’s - Roll Dice, Fight Monsters, Loot Dungeons, Embrace Death, and unravel The Secret of Weepstone.

3884620.description: Bearly Brave is a 2D roguelike deck-building game set in a deceptively charming toy shop, where the cutest teddy bears come to life each night to fight in a no-holds-barred tournament that determines their placement on the shelves, and thus their likeness to be taken to their forever home.

3888200.description: "SandTable War: Three Kingdoms" is a strategic simulation game set during the Three Kingdoms period. Here you can play as various factions from Three Kingdoms history to conquer cities and lands, unify the realm. With abundant historical officers and scenarios, come restore the Han Dynasty!

3900710.description: Break Nyx’s curse and guide humanity's rebirth in this top-down 2.5D Action RPG Demo Version from the creators of CrossCode. Battle enemies with stylish combos, wield multiple divine weapons, solve intriguing puzzles and explore a changing world.

3908510.description: The political drama set in a future that's too close for comfort. Become the first mayor of ARTEMIS: A Pioneering Lunar City. Navigate the future of lunar colonization, choose between independence and cooperation, shape policies for or against AI influence, and tackle interplanetary conspiracies.

3911940.description: Elemency Island is a cozy farm and automation game in coop multiplayer. Plant, raise animals, sell your ressources to unlock technologies and automate your entire farm. Alone, or with your friends, come discover this island full of surprises and unknown creatures.

3913680.description: Sara – a brutal, nonlinear visual novel about sins committed and the final chance for redemption. Are you worthy of forgiveness?

3919260.description: Create the ultimate tabletop gaming store! Design a storefront, collect your own miniatures, and compete against customers in epic game nights. Manage and expand your business until you’re the number one hobbyist hub in town!

3920800.description: This is an HD-2D pixel-style side-scrolling action shooter survival horror game. Players will take on the role of Laila, a senior agent from a mysterious organization, partnering with her companion Flora to investigate a bizarre art gallery

3921450.description: Causal Loop is a narrative puzzler in which you solve intricate puzzles on a remote alien world by using the unique “echo” mechanic. Record, replay, and interact with past versions of yourself in this demo for Causal Loop!

3939070.description: Build your own base in Global Rescue and take command of firefighting, police, EMS, and SWAT operations — either in your hometown or any city around the world! Manage your fleet, hire staff, and take on a variety of authentic operations. Are you ready for your shift?
