3939620.description: Shatter genre boundaries in this sci-fi survival Roguelite blending bullet-hell action and base-building RTS. Dodge and unleash screen-clearing firepower against alien hordes, while constructing fortresses and real-time automated defenses to crush your enemies.

3949050.description: A tactical survival and outpost management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat—it’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines.

videos.nom: Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare Official Trailer #1 EN

3952670.description: Boarding house owner Yuman is back! Mal-sook, Gran, and Min-jung return—joined by three new residents: a wealthy heiress, a girl haunted by childhood scars, and a gentle nurse with a healing heart. In a house where past memories and fresh feelings intertwine… who will steal your heart?

3955580.description: A whispering flame craves souls. With each offering, your resolve strengthens. Fight spirits, collect their essences, and feed a hunger that may never subside in this short eerie incremental game.

3965690.description: Apollo Sonata is a 2D story-driven exploration ADV.This demo offers about 30 minutes of gameplay, covering around 70% of the first playthrough.Explore the nighttime campus as Miu and uncover its hidden mysteries.

3967390.description: Legion Warfare，Roguelike，Loot Grinding，Semi-Automated Combat，Western Fantasy，Top-Down Combat. You control a hero, command a powerful army, unleash devastating magic, build formidable defenses, and manage resource gathering to withstand relentless enemy assaults.
3967390.developpeur: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.

3969060.description: UMIGARI is a first-person harpoon fishing game set in the foggy waters off the coast of Japan. Hunt fish with your harpoon, sell your catch, buy fuel, and upgrade your gear. Alone at sea, the more you explore, the stranger the fish become.

3969600.description: The Fable: Manga Build Roguelike combines manga, tactical puzzles, and roguelike gameplay into one thrilling experience. Enjoy stylish pixel-art action while testing your flexible thinking and precise strategy!

3972920.description: A third-person action RPG that brings to life the world of Gaia from the Anima: Beyond Fantasy RPG table-top books. Explore a deep and multifaceted story where your choices and actions directly impact the journey and decide the fate of the characters.

3973960.description: Wander a castle built of bitter memories in LOVE ETERNAL, a psychological horror platformer with devious trials and an unsettling, experimental narrative. Find a way out - or live in Shelter forever more.

3976570.description: Demons are not the danger, YOU ARE THE DANGER!!! play as Angelica Amadeus, a nun with the power of faith and guns. Slay demons at your heart's content on bizarre stages with strange gravity fields. Get highscores to unlock more stages and weapons and teach those filthy demons their place.

3978510.description: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelite. Fight chaotic battles in the Colosseum while chained to your friends. Brave physical and mental injuries that change how you play. Entertain the blood-thirsty crowd by unleashing your inner beast.

3979510.description: Welcome to ​Rhythm Animal Café​! Animals' daily chaos meets funky beats: boss hype, colleague woes, your slacking, unfair blame—all become hilarious one-tap rhythm games! Simple controls, joyful groove. Feel music fuse with daily life’s warmth!

3987580.description: 毕业自驾游？不，是「心动修罗场」！ 《盛夏离与合》是现象级互动影像系列《完蛋！我被美女包围了！》IP的全新篇章。本次我们将填补“完蛋宇宙”时间线上的关键一块，带你回到那个承前启后、充满无限可能的毕业季，体验一段关于成长、抉择与命运交织的动人故事。 这段承前启后的夏日篇章，都会因你每一次的抉择，导向独一无二的盛夏结局。

3988710.description: The key feature in Nightmare Circus is the “Puppet String” mechanic. The player can use the puppeteer’s sticks as a weapon, alongside a Control Bar to fend off hostile enemies, as well as to traverse, manoeuvre, and attack with our unique Collision Combat system.

videos.nom: Nightmare Circus | Steam Next Fest February 2026

3989510.description: Tactical deckbuilding in bite-sized sessions. Launch dice to create magical chain reactions. Choose from distinct hero classes with unique abilities. Build synergies between dice, relics, and runes to defeat challenging bosses.

3989770.description: City Building PvP Auto Battler! Build your kingdom with powerful weapons, walls, houses, and endless synergies, then battle other wizards in asynchronous multiplayer. The SkyShard Demo includes the full unrestricted game until we enter Early Access.

3991920.description: Craft original weapons and engage in strategic time-freezing battles as you dive into the million-floor deep underground world of this deep-diving action strategy game.

3996940.description: Begin your new job as a servant at the mysterious Vanderboom estate. Solve puzzles, serve the family and uncover their dark alchemical secrets in Servant of the Lake, a new upcoming single-player point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series.

4006090.description: Froggin Around is a two player local co-op game where you play as two mischievous frogs on a magical quest! Use your stretchy, bouncy tongues to swing, grab objects, and help each other hop through puzzles and chaotic challenges in this light-hearted, physics-based co-op adventure!

4029380.description: You are a disease. Infect the human body as a lone pathogen in this cellular roguelike shooter. Collect organelles to evolve your parasite in a microscopic arms race against your host's immune system. Conquer a beautiful, procedurally generated world of tiny proportions.

4050060.description: An online co-op detective horror for up to 3 players. Work together across randomly generated shifts to investigate your customers, as some are only pretending to be human. Make one mistake, and you’ll be forced to board up, set traps, and hide.

4054570.description: Build and automate your own ant colony – a nest that runs itself! Freely dig and shape your underground kingdom, produce different types of ants, and grow it block by block. Then it's time for conquest: scale up your swarm, crush enemy bases, and lead your colony to victory in the wild forest!

4054670.description: Step into the role of Embla, an android with a human consciousness, and experience a post-apocalyptic world inspired by Norse mythology. Solve puzzles, overcome platforming challenges, and face intense battles in a vast, exploration-driven open world.

4057420.description: Fight through post-apocalyptic South Korea in this retro survival horror. Uncover the truth behind the devastating meteor impact that left the country in ruins and turned every living organism into a terrifying monstrosity. Fight. Solve puzzles. Upgrade gear. Make every bullet count.

4057540.description: These moronic Terranoids think they can just roll in here and take over my beautiful Tyrythian kingdom? The kingdom that I built from the ground up with my bare hands, and only sort of inherited from my dear, sweet, extremely dead father? This is complete bullsh*t, and I'm going to make them dead.

4057780.description: Get ready to face your most epic battle yet in this old-school real-time strategy game! In this demo version, meet (or remember!) the mechanics and witness the starting point of Outlive 25's epic campaign!

4058240.description: Shroud of Gloom is a point-and-click horror adventure. Investigate an old manor, gather items and clues to solve environmental puzzles and discover dark secrets. Can you uncover the mystery… and make it out alive?

4059020.description: 1-3 player co-op Openworld Action RPG that creates a balanced, accessible experience for everyone. Using a unique world and character progression system, explore vast hand-crafted lands together, uncover hidden treasures, level up your town, and push back the darkness with light. (Old Build Demo)

4062070.description: Shipwrecked in Antarctica, survivors cross the frozen glaciers and step beyond an ice wall into the boundless Great Thousand Worlds. A sandbox RPG centered on exploration and experimentation, featuring deeper systems, a vastly expanded world, and long-term progression shaped by player choice.

videos.nom: 大千世界2DEMO 新品节宣传

4068140.description: Collect words, find powerful combinations of boosters, and achieve the highest score! In this dynamic word game, you will find dozens of artifacts, unusual upgrades, and colorful characters who are ready to raise a ruckus!

4073060.description: REPEATER is a one-hit to kill, online arena shooter where the arenas repeat infinitely. Forward is backward. Up is down. You have been here before.

4075460.description: As a Ming officer in 1645’s Yangzhou & Jiangyin massacres, shield a girl from shouma fate while obeying orders. In 1937’s Battle of Yangzhou, protect a war journalist returned from Japan. Your choices decide their survival and shape their fates across 300 years.

4080380.description: "Let's play a typing game." Dyping Escape is a simple game where you type according to instructions from the game master, a mysterious eyeball. But be careful; everything you type becomes reality. Just be careful not to brick your computer.

4081580.description: Moulder is a fast-paced hack-and-slash game with a focus on boss fights. Master your weapons and command an army of loyal maggots to overwhelm prey much larger than you.

4091760.description: You are trapped in the observatory of a star-obsessed professor atop Mount Clearveil. Plan your survival during the day, confront the darkness of the basement at night. Can you break the ritual and uncover the mystery?

videos.nom: Life and Shadow: Celestial Call Gameplay Trailer

4091980.description: Bouncemasters 2: Pengu Throw is a sequel to the 300-million-downloads fun arcade hit and a predecessor to the legendary Yetisports! Grab your bat, line up the perfect swing and bounce your way around Levels Map. Chase glory while branching biomes packed with hazards, boosters and memes!

videos.nom: Bouncemasters 2: Pengu Throw | Demo Release Trailer

4092490.description: Pogo Panic is a difficult, Parkour Adventure. Bounce on a pogo stick, ignite a fleeting jetpack, and vault through space. One slip-jump takes you back to the start-no checkpoints. Fail, rebound, and master the sky one desperate hop at a time.

4094290.description: Build your own restoration business as you trim, mow and clear overgrown spaces, craft tools from salvaged materials, and bring neglected places back into shape one project at a time.

4094560.description: Hoptale is a Roguelite adventure that fuses hopscotch with a slot machine. Play as Tuby, a rabbit whose only weapon is his jump, against the awakened God of Chaos. In battle the tiles below spin into reels — call the stop, line up attacks, strike. Collect tiles, build your run, outsmart chaos.

4095730.description: Experience Will's complicated story, find a way out of the nightmare of liminal spaces by solving challenging puzzles and avoiding dangerous entities — all this awaits you in "Shifting To The Backrooms".

videos.nom: Shifting To The Backrooms - Main Trailer
Shifting To The Backrooms - First Trailer

4100440.description: Gamble your way out of hell in this blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deckbuilder. Play powerful card combos or cheat to outwit your opponents and earn your freedom. Win their Soul coins! Bribe the ferryman! And uncover the story of those who stand in your way.

4101720.description: Explore surreal liminal spaces in this first-person psychological horror game. No-clip through shifting realities and uncover a quiet mystery as the Shroud closes in. DEMO includes first 5 chapters!

4103070.description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you cast elemental spells, outwit monstrous foes, and escape prison on your way to your niece’s birthday party.

4107750.description: Examine a family's photo album to reveal signs of the paranormal, as the horror unfolds in the house around you. Their fate is in your hands.

4108400.description: The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop. Cook Hamburg, serve customers, and upgrade your shop for more menu items.

4109100.description: Raise your daughter while she attends a magical academy. Choose which classes she attends, jobs she does, training she undergoes, and more in a character raising sim packed full of story and over 50 endings to reach. How she grows up to be the world's cutest princess depends on you!

4109130.description: Protected by his headphones, Felix has broken free from the loudspeakers’ control and finds himself in the streets of the cardboard city of Phonopolis. Explore the Workers’ Quarter with him and tune in to a story about a city ruled by the Leader’s commands.

4109680.description: Wake up on a paradise-like abandoned island with your friends. Explore the lands of an ancient civilization and uncover the mysteries behind their collapse as you build, craft, and tame corrupted machines. Most importantly, survive the unwelcome lands of Elysium!

4119380.description: It Reaches is a first person horror game, captured through the lens of a police officer’s body cam. Trapped inside the facilities of an abandoned hospital, find a way to escape the horrors lurking underground. Uncover a dark mystery left behind and don't get caught! They will reach for you…

4122440.description: Handgun Football Demo shatters physics: FPS meets soccer brawl. Revolvers, shotguns blast the ball into rival goals. Solo vs AI, slide from chill to hell; LAN or global 2 teams,up to 12 players.More modes will be unlocked in the full version.

4123850.description: Plant, grow, and harvest in this farming roguelite deckbuilder. Craft a powerful deck of plants and combine quirky scarecrows with passive effects for wild synergies. Pay taxes. Strategic, satisfying, and delightfully wholesome. Try DEMO now!

4125500.description: Staffer Retro is a mystery adventure game where you uncover past incidents related to ‘Mana’, the source of supernatural powers. Gather information through dialogue and exploration, and piece together clues found in documents to guide the choices of Verita Retro, the protagonist.

4183220.description: hitogata is a story driven adventure game about dolls, electricity, and ending the world with your friends.

4183290.description: The level hides when you move in this skill-based action game. Scan the level, then step into the dark. Dodge deadly threats, outmaneuver enemies, and defeat brutal bosses to reclaim the stolen sun. No map. No safety. Just your skill. Demo Out Now!

4184150.description: Golf, but make it illegal. Defy your club membership ban & wreak havoc at courses across the city with your friends. Hide from security, defend yourself with a customisable arsenal, and take your games to the most outrageous places. Who said a tower crane wasn't the perfect place for a hole-in-one?

4197180.description: Our story begins with a letter, a phone call, and a break-in at Everhart Manor. Play the first part of Lovecraftian puzzle adventure Call of the Elder Gods, featuring save data carryover to the full game.

4206970.description: Design your defenses, build your module board, and manage your wires. Combine signals and create synergies to empower your weapons and survive in this base-defense roguelike auto-battler.

4209250.description: Turn your balcony into your very own birdwatching spot, and await the arrival of new avian friends! Enjoy a cozy idle game — place a tiny postcard on the corner of your screen, keeping you company with pleasant scenes and visiting birds. Oh, and don't forget your camera!

4210280.description: A surreal strategy game for clowns and criminals.

4211230.description: Your MUSIC powers your WEAPONS, and it powers your ENEMIES. Gameplay synchronizes to any music playing on your computer - yes, even streaming.

4213590.description: Open-world logic puzzle game about building a forest by laying tiles.

4224400.description: After his grandmother's death, Artyom's mother asked him to return to the old farmhouse to collect some documents. It seemed like a simple task. But at midnight, someone tries to get into the house... You must uncover the secrets of this place and the truth that has been hidden for so long.

4226970.description: Create unique creatures, use them to gather rare resources, and fuse them into even more powerful beings! This RPG combines classic exploration with a deep crafting system where your monsters are your ultimate tool for looting, combat, and discovery.

4228490.description: From one-person online store to e-commerce giant - pack, drive and deliver orders across the open world of Pionero Island. Grow with employees, vehicles, properties and new businesses until the company runs without you. Solo or co-op

4230470.description: Clock in. Survive the shift. HMUR is a brutal, fast-paced FPS where one shot can kill and ammo is precious. An ordinary factory worker must blast his way through a facility gone violently out of control — before he loses his grip on reality.

4234410.description: Hunt eldritch horrors in the cursed lands of Transylvania. Stalk your prey with blades and bullets, craft your ideal loadout, and conduct unnatural rituals in this gothic shooter.

4237150.description: In the visual novel "Eternity, Stars, and Everyday Life," you are Lin Xiaocou, an ordinary office worker whose life is turned upside down when two girls from another world unexpectedly move in. Amidst the light-hearted and joyful daily routines, can you discover a unique happiness for everyone?

4237760.description: In the midst of war, a far more personal horror takes root at home. Your mother is becoming a monster. Survive, uncover the truth, and navigate a heartbreaking bond in this unique stop-motion narrative horror adventure.

4243390.description: Locked-room mystery meets sweet romance in this immersive visual novel! Solve tricky chamber puzzles and meet lively girls. Dynamic sprites, multiple endings shaped by your choices. Want more? The official anime adaptation is on Crunchyroll. Search X&Y for extra stories!

4244410.description: Get a first look at Planet of Lana II, a cinematic puzzle-platformer and epic sci-fi adventure that’s built around companionship, exploration, and emotional storytelling.

4245250.description: Try a first slice of Robert’s bureaucratic quest through the derelict capital of Afro-Eurasia. The demo includes 4 levels, multiplayer, shortcuts, and a few surprises. Run, jump, climb, slide, and exploit momentum as you search for the fastest route.

4246880.description: Play as Madeleine, a retired granny recruited by the Granny Detective Society (basically the CIA… but add dentures). Investigate your neighbors, figure out their names and professions, and uncover all their secrets in this no-murder detective game full of white hair and mugs of tea.

4247130.description: Flamecraft is a 1-5 player cozy strategy game filled with magic. Become a Flamekeeper and help adorable dragon artisans find the perfect home. Enchant the town’s stores and fill them with dragon cards as you watch the whimsical shopping district come to life.

4247370.description: Explore a vast and hazardous cave network and uncover mountains of loot. Build a town and trade with NPCs using advanced building and lighting tools. Fight bosses and raid dungeons to unlock abilities. Play with your friends, and build, fight, thrive, in the fully destructible world of Allumeria!

4247830.description: SPRAWL zero is a fast-paced shooter inspired by the Golden Age of 2000s FPS. Survive a brutal cyberpunk city collapsing under military rule and cult fanaticism. Use your Gravity-Gloves, augments, and an arsenal of over 40 weapons to crush those who stand in your way.

4248450.description: Solve criminal cases through the power of SQL queries! Help out the city of Los Zorangeles by becoming a Database Detective in this new (unpaid) work from home opportunity.

4253670.description: STARDUST: Wish of Witch is a single-player SRPG beautifully crafted in pixel art. Follow the secret of the wish-granting star and join the adventure of the girl “Star” and the mage “Yu”.

4257770.description: You'll be "Xie En", infiltrating the traitor's money empire. This urban hunt is a revenge saga where wit is your spear. Return as "Wu Wei," using rules as your shield in a world of grey. Will you choose love or vengeance? This lethal game of cash, betrayal and redemption awaits your move.

4264890.description: From letters to lunacy, Cursed Words is a roguelike chasing ever-stronger synergies. Start with simple words like BUY or THIS or GAME, then use game-altering combos to break the rules. Before long you’ll be ¼♖♙K5XNG the ⅗H♗4 out of these 83VK??7?!

4265210.description: Step into the boots of the castle guard. Inspect seals, expose smugglers and reveal witches. You decide who enters and who’s turned away. Will you uphold the law, or break it for your own gain?

4265610.description: Play the MATCHO Demo and experience one complete story mission. Explore, solve puzzles, talk to characters, and jump into real-time Match-3 combat (mark targets, build chains, execute combos) in this narrative first-person action adventure.

4267580.description: Die Deep is an action game focused purely on the confrontation with your enemies. No exploration, no puzzles, The only core is Combat. One reckless move or greedy strike, and it’s all over. Answer the silent call of the abyss. Descend into the depths to find your forgotten desires.

4271300.description: A handcrafted hidden-object game inspired by the joy of people watching. Pet cats, shake trees, peek through windows and discover a delightful world filled with secrets and stories.

4271600.description: Kalanoro is an action-adventure platformer where you build a band of lemur artists. Explore Lemuria, recruit lemur musicians, grow your band and use platforming and combat to fight the witch Raneny, one song at a time.

4273410.description: Rocket-jump using explosive fireballs, unlock abilities and master an ever-growing movement system. Explore the non-linear corners of the underworld, find secrets, defeat demons and reclaim the Eye of Evil.

4273900.description: Cards of Prophecy combines Tower Defense, Deckbuilding, and Roguelike elements, with huge inspiration from Trading Card Games. Build an ever evolving deck to summon monsters and use powerful spells. Fuse, defend, open card packs, create new strategies. Repeat.

4274660.description: A survivors-like bullet heaven with 1-4 player ONLINE CO-OP. Battle across the realm and take on hordes of monsters! Strategically choose your weapons and items to craft powerful builds, challenge bosses, and complete quests. Unlock new characters and unleash their unique weapons and abilities.

4276860.description: In a world controlled by strings, YOU are not attached. Fight your way through champions of ancient fairy tales in this action packed boss-rush game, escape the grip of The Puppeteer, and write your own ending.

videos.nom: Puppeteer: No Strings Attached Demo Trailer

4281330.description: A dark cozy ‘Romantasy’ furnishing game where a vampire kidnaps his beloved and tries to win her heart by turning his eerie castle into their dream home.

4282040.description: Survive a 10-day demon invasion during the 1645 Yangzhou Massacre. As a mad scholar, protect an innocent girl while unraveling a courtesan's tragic death. This visual novel weaves brutal survival with beautiful memories of a lost Ming romance, ultimately finding hope in the darkness.

videos.nom: 哀鸿《城破：十日记》正式版PV
我又幻想了，我回到了崇祯年间的扬州城，重新见到了她。

4286280.description: Stock and manage your Gacha Capsule Machines in this shop simulator. Help your collectors chase rare pulls, welcome anime lovers, and turn Akihabara into a true gacha paradise. Build your own capsule figure collection aswell, from giant mecha robots and kawaii cat maids to iconic meme figures.

4287940.description: "Those who skip Galgames are mere corporate drones; those who play are the true masters of wealth and power. That's just the way of the world! As an ordinary boy, wager your wildest fetishes and your dignity to reach the summit: Become the 'GALGAME GOD'!

4290960.description: Free demo. Lootbound is a tactical loot management roguelike: start solo, build your party on the way, choose routes/risks/rewards, equip heroes and companions, and craft a build to face a final boss shaped by your choices. Turn-based, synergies, fair difficulty.

4292850.description: Set in 1972 (Showa 47), this story follows a high school student on his yearly summer visit to his grandparents’ rural home. Spending quiet, nostalgic days with his sister and the villagers, he begins to believe this peaceful summer might last… until an encounter in the mountains changes everything.

4295280.description: Oneirophobia is a survival horror game with elements of psychological horror, thriller and drama. Experience the role of a person suffering from a fear of dreams. Run, hide, and be quiet. Help the main character overcome his fear by going through all the nightmares of our subconscious.

videos.nom: Oneirophobia Demo - Steam Next Fest Trailer

4297010.description: Explore your decaying mind in this retro survival horror FPS. Manage scarce resources, solve puzzles, and push forward through the dread.

4300600.description: Distant Shore: BRETAGNE is a first-person parkour physics based game, where you wield your magnetic gauntlets to move, bend and break metal obstacles. Navigate through a ravaged world to complete the mission given by your employer.

4300770.description: A digital fidget box of dopamine-fueled micro-challenges. Push buttons. Shoot targets. Chain actions for higher scores. Complete all tasks. Don’t ask questions.

4303790.description: Acrolyte is a 2D action-adventure platformer which brings the player through vast, mysterious alien landscapes. Awaken from your dying rest in an endless pursuit of revenge against ancient forces beyond your own comprehension.

4307610.description: Death isn’t the end - it’s your last chance. Solve haunting puzzles and make choices that matter as you guide Vale across the underworld. Will regret follow her into eternity?

4307720.description: Lock and load into the Starship Troopers universe and join the Mobile Infantry in the most realistic depiction of war ever made! Experience an original story in this action-packed, first-person retro shooter. Would you like to know more?

4308410.description: Map a mysterious land during the Age of Enlightenment between two warring kingdoms. The game’s 20 minute demo will introduce you the basics of cartography, the strange happenings in Runnymere, and the love story between a farmer and a sailor.

4310820.description: Fracture Field is an incremental quarry mining game. Shatter rocks with timed swings then invest your earnings into upgrades. Build a fleet of drones to automate your empire, bomb tough layers, and unlock powerful prestige upgrades on your journey to master the quarry.

4310990.description: In this realm of shadows rumors and urban legends become reality, and danger lurks around every corner. If a living intruder dies here, their body will be severed from their spirit and never wake again ... Welcome to The Coma 3: Bloodlines demo.

4317840.description: Congratulations on starting your new company. Your goal is simple. Make money, lots of it, by any means necessary. Hire hordes of staff, burn them out, then throw them away. After all, don't you want to be happy? Money buys happiness.

4319270.description: In this stop-motion inspired adventure, play as detective Ambroise Niflette in the thrilling investigation of the search for the stolen bell in a mysterious village.

4319990.description: Chain massive trick combos, dodge deadly debris, and chase huge scores in this fast-paced arcade adventure. Earn coins, upgrade abilities, collect rare items, and uncover a wild time-bending narrative aboard this doomed flight in the year 1995

4320000.description: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.

4320630.description: The family computer is infected again and it’s your job to fend off waves of viruses and adware foes with an arsenal of nostalgic Y2K-inspired weapons. Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional is a survivor-like auto-shooter filled with nods to the days when computers were actually fun.

4321140.description: Try the opening of DIVE or DIE in this free demo. Experience the complete tutorial and survive your first 10 days. Every descent is a deadly gamble. DIVE or DIE in the cursed abyss, face Eldritch horrors to uncover the mystery of the black rain. Scavenge and upgrade, recruit and sacrifice.

4322950.description: WHODUNNIT: Hitting Singles is the first episode of a comedic mystery visual novel following a man who must answer a burning question: who the hell did he hook up with last night?

4335510.description: Horses of Hoofprint Bay is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D point and click barn buildup game. Take care of your horses, train them to build up their strength and confidence, and compete for prize money! Breed adorable foals, hire and manage staff, and build the stable of your dreams!

4338170.description: A dice roguelike about feeding a dragon for twenty years. Roll ingredients, build your island, and fuse absurd recipes into combos that break the score wide open. Miss a meal and you're next on the menu.

4343530.description: The Skin Stapler is a retro-styled PSX grindhouse horror adventure set in the rotting, crime-soaked sprawl of Carrion City. Players follow jaded detective Dick Slater and his eager rookie partner Robbie Knox as they hunt a mysterious serial killer known only as The Skin Stapler.

4344070.description: ShipShaper is a creative game about the simple joy of designing ships. Nothing more. Nothing less. Export to Bulwark, 3D print, or use in your own games with a free commercial license.

4344670.description: Catch a train to Cat Isle! In this cozy pixel art management game, build restaurants, expand and decorate the town. Figure out your cats needs as they dine, shop, explore and turn the island into their purfect home.

4346840.description: Adorable sushi race at full speed in a training × racing game! Become a sushi chef, craft unique toppings, and enter your trained sushi into races. Don't forget to cheer on your sushi during the race. Win the prestigious S1 Cup championship, and become a top-tier sushi chef!

4348210.description: Break Shoot combines the precision of billiards with roguelike builds. Stack powerful ball abilities and accessories to explode your score and crush each round's target!

4349450.description: Take your first shift at Rewind 99 as the last video rental store standing. Run the shop, upgrade your store, unlock early side hustles, and begin building your rental empire while exploring the rich world of Reshoot Springs. Whatever it takes to survive - solo or in 4-player co-op.

4349840.description: Orcs don’t die: THEY RAGE! Embody their Warchief and lead them out of misery in this brutish strategy game with base-building, where one Orc outburst can turn victory into disaster. Forge bonds between units, shape their personalities, and unleash their true potential both in and out of battle.

videos.nom: Don't Kill Them All - Early Demo Trailer

4350800.description: A Romanian folk horror about a simple farmer, a wealthy neighbor, and a hunger for money that leads to an unforgivable sin.

4352780.description: A case opening roguelite where you trade illegal weapons on the dark web to pay off a debt... or die.

4353050.description: I'm Tom and I just got a job as a bartender. Now I have to wipe down the same sticky counters where I used to leave my own marks. In this dive, even the rats look like they're hungover. Alright, the boozers won't pour their own drinks - time to get back to work.

4356050.description: Feed and raise your little baby. Watch it grow and feed on every and anything. In Full Bloom is a Tamagotchi inspired Katamari-like about a creature with never-ending hunger for anything around it. There is only one way.

videos.nom: In Full Bloom | Release Date Announcement | 2026

4356670.description: August 2006. A prequel to the main game. Before the new ranger arrives, you must finish your final shift: patrol the area, check the camera traps, and file the end-of-day report. Over the radio, your partner discusses vacation plans. It’s a quiet evening... or so it seems.

videos.nom: Uncanny Tales: The Watcher - Demo Trailer

4357360.description: Chapter 1 of A Stray Line. Explore a strange world, draw to cast spells, and begin a story about a lonely little family in the woods.

4358400.description: Grow weed and grow your business! Run your own weed supermarket, manage stock, set prices, and help customers. Try new strains, choose the best products, upgrade your shop, and keep your store running smoothly so people always come back.

4362430.description: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

4362700.description: Smash and thrash the mysterious Forever Chicken, a living ragdoll central to a frightful midnight carnival. Your Uncle Tontine assures "you can leave as soon as you desire" but despite their efforts no child has ever gone home... Will you be the first?

4363050.description: The gear you acquire completely transforms your party’s roles. Erehwon is a loot-driven dungeon crawler where you progress by reshaping your builds around the gear you find.

4366000.description: All Hail The Orb: Demo offers a short pixel art incremental experience focused on upgrading the Orb, recruiting cultists, and automation. Designed to take 20–30 minutes, the demo showcases the core progression, humour, and tone of the full game.

4369630.description: Step into the Medieval Mediterranean and live the life of a winemaker. From growing your vineyard to harvesting, from crafting wine to trading, every decision shapes your future. Will you be the one who creates the most exquisite and valuable wine? 🍷

4369950.description: Try the opening of CALX in this free demo. Experience the full tutorial and get a glimpse of the Canyon. Flow across the WARP-corrupted planet Syro. Master movement as the Seeker. Scan, solve puzzles, and engage in measured combat in waves of stillness and frenzy.

4371160.description: Journey into the forgotten world of Helix, where ancient powers awaken within you. Unlock and combine embodied abilities to unravel the mysteries of a lost civilization. Descend into a tale that will challenge your mind and soul, solving intricate puzzles as you ascend to the light of a new day.

videos.nom: Helix: Descent N Ascent - Release Date Trailer

4371660.description: Put the ‘love’ in 'Lovecraftian horror!' When a captivating comet named Hheily crashes into your apartment, you are drawn into an interplanetary conflict between light and dark. Feed Hheily's fire to save the world in this horror-comedy visual novel… and maybe even win a smooch!

4374740.description: Cage an angel. Ransack Heaven. In a far-flung dystopian future, the Angel Engine Initiative carries on as the last hope for humanity. Seal yourself in your operating room, perform surgery on comatose test subjects, and pray you make it out alive.

4377540.description: Are you ready, comrades? In this turn-based hex wargame akin to Unity of Command, you will command the People's Liberation Army of China to strike a heavy blow against the revanchist reactionary forces during the War of Liberation and achieve the liberation of all China!

videos.nom: Crimson Banner: War of Liberation Demo Gameplay Trailer

4380660.description: It's time to begin our preliminary experiment. My CommGear isn't fully operational yet, but I want to get started with what we have now. I'm looking forward to collaborating with you on this project.

4380930.description: Assassinate your targets with style, as you uncover a plot of world domination and ancient horrors in this boss fight action game. Dive deep into the dark ruins of the Beast City, where only lunatic killers remain.

4389360.description: In this twist on a harmless pet simulator, take care of Pepper, who happens to be a giant purple dog. But when things go awry, you will have to decide: how many lives is one good boy worth?

4389650.description: Rise against the corporate overlords and become a cyber activist hacker. Join the uprising in a cyberpunk world using radio waves.

4408590.description: Tongue-grapple and pinball-bounce the frog prince across levels to reach the Witch’s Banquet in this hand-drawn 2D platformer. Each whimsical world has its own wacky boss, hidden collectibles, and a unique traversal ability. Grit your teeth! You're gonna CROAK.

4419920.description: There are secrets everywhere... Enter a strange and whimsical pastiche of 1980s Americana, where a conspiracy beyond your wildest dreams rocks the country. Join a thrilling cast of characters as they fight for the future in this turn-based RPG!

4421880.description: Begin the story of Catechesis: meet the main characters, explore the first dungeons, and face demons in an intense one-hour gameplay.

4422450.description: DAICE is a unique merge of turn-based dice-powered combat with inventory management, a roguelite where you control an evergrowing AI Core. Purchase and pilot unique spaceships, load your dice into weapons and systems, and unleash devastating combos and shape your own strategy-driven story.

4422700.description: Don't Play This is a demo of an indie first-person horror walking simulator.. A scary story caught on camera. Can you play it?

4439600.description: The Rabbit Haul is a roguelite farming and tower defense game that challenges you to grow crops, build symbiotic defenses, and protect your haul from the thieving Trash Panda Posse as you rebuild your hometown one run at a time!

4440630.description: minesweeper, but with a skill tree.

4442640.description: Fighting is hard, right? Let your party do it for you! Romance Monster Girls and traverse the Dungeon! Hopefully they'll all get along... right?

videos.nom: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart | Demo Launch Trailer
Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart | Announcement Trailer

4442860.description: An audio restoration job becomes an investigation into the occult, as an elusive musician’s damaged cassette tapes are exhumed in northern Italy. Use a fully-operational desktop to sift through files, descending into the artist’s world in this slow-burning ghost tale of creativity and obsession.

4454550.description: A grimy, neon filled immersive sim set in a dystopian alternate history 1972. Sneak, fight, and trick your way through a beautifully ugly city, and discover the world of Spectra.

4458010.description: Fight through a train overtaken by monsters and survive Antarctica’s cold as paranormal special agent Doug Barker in this chilling single-player third-person survival horror roguelike.

4459730.description: Airport Control is a next-generation 3D ATC simulation. Take the positions at airports worldwide—marshalling taxis, sequencing departures, and spacing arrivals. Remember: Safe, orderly, expeditious.

4465780.description: A strategic roguelite auto-battler for 1-3 players. Travel through time, recruit historical figures, and gear them up with badass equipment for ridiculous combos. Master tactical missions solo or with friends. Ready to save the world?

4468530.description: Sublight is a space bullet heaven roguelike, where you captain a powerful warship and carve through escalating waves of enemies. Upgrade your arsenal, unlock new ships, and experiment with countless builds to dominate the battlefield.

4475210.description: You're an Inquisitor following a trail of death. A cult is at work, your predecessor has vanished, and the region teeters on the edge of chaos. Find the truth. Uphold the Inquisition. Do not fail.

4475540.description: SKINFACE is a short-and-punchy stealth game where you embody a faceless hitman who needs to steal the faces of others to gain the trust of their target. Set in dark soviet-era apartment complexes, evade the police and get your victim to open up the door for you. Knock, knock!

4480440.description: Loop Tower tells the story of adventurers climbing an endless tower. Place it on a corner of your desktop and help them continue their ascent. Experience a fresh blend of desktop idle gameplay + roguelike + RPG right now!

4487020.description: Connections are like fiber threads—tugged and tangled. Some tighten; others fray. Grades, the future, and family expectations steal her breath. Between closeness and distance, hope and avoidance, she tries to understand—and be understood. This demo features the early chapters of the full game.

4487250.description: Build an impossible tower. Defend it against endless sieges. Watch it crumble, then rebuild stronger.

videos.nom: The Tower Must Fall - Release Gameplay Trailer

4493160.description: Clean, mine and refine pollution in this active incremental game. Cruise through the countryside earning cash and resources, build a refinery, process materials, upgrade equipment, unlock new areas and complete quests.

4501780.description: Cat Me If You Can is a charming and cozy game where you explore beautifully handcrafted black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats to photograph and bring their colours back into the world.

4505330.description: With the ability to hijack the minds of anyone who answers a phone call, "0" builds an army of remote controlled assassins to overthrow his twin brother, "1" as standing president.

4512720.description: They messed with your homeland. A violent demon saved you from death and now pushes you to get revenge. In this Hack and Slash, explore a revolutionary land, merge with the environment, and consume your enemies' fear to unleash the Zupay.

4513990.description: In this first-person psychological horror, you are Frank Doyle, a professional home stager hired to prepare a vacant house for sale. The Ward family vanished months ago, leaving everything behind. At first, your job seems easy, but the house isn't as empty as it seems.

4516230.description: Feed the AI. Collect data. Unlock upgrades. Watch the algorithm grow beyond your control. An active incremental where you feed an evolving AI with data and shape what it becomes. Will it save the world… or take it over?

4518150.description: This is a cozy, narrative and dark game in which you clean oil off the beach, sort out trash and rescue animals. Relaxing cleanup in a post-apocalyptic world.

4532800.description: Free demo of the full Police Chief Simulator game takes you to Winston Springs Police Station! Handle incoming reports, renovate and expand the station, solve cases, and fight crime!

videos.nom: Police Chief Simulator Release Date Announcement Teaser
Police Chief Simulator DEMO - Release Date Announcement Teaser

4534390.description: Loot Frog is an incremental action bullet hell about breaking pots, collecting gems, and fighting an evil cult. Upgrade your gear, unlock new abilities, explore diverse biomes, and push deeper into increasingly chaotic battles.

4536190.description: Splatter blobs with your friends, unlock never-before-seen Goobies with unique abilities, discover powerful genetic goobie mutations and combine omens for the second blobbath experience in Goobies 2!

4536430.description: Exorcise hordes of demons using gun-wielding nuns and angels in this survivors-like bullet heaven! Collect and keep angels with unique weapons, stats, and abilities to create god-like builds as you fend off waves of enemies! Do you have enough faith to survive?

4538840.description: James Miller, a 36-year-old lighthouse keeper, returns to work after a brief visit with his sister Olivia. Used to solitude, the sea and empty rooms, he senses the lighthouse feels different this time—and his routine shift is becoming something he never expected.

videos.nom: Things to Forget - Lighthouse Demo (Official Teaser)

4540450.description: The Heavens are done waiting. In this dark fantasy dungeon crawler RPG, the Archon descends to end the demon war once and for all. Make your stand in HellSlave II, more immersive, brutal, and customizable than ever. The reckoning begins now.

4542970.description: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming of age story where every choice carries weight.

videos.nom: Come to my Party! Demo Announcement Trailer

4545970.description: Beencremental is a colorful incremental game where you guide the Queen Bee, forage pollen and turn every drop into honey. Upgrade your hive, grow an unstoppable swarm, and conquer four changing seasons as your production climbs from a few bees to a buzzing empire.

4546880.description: Operate a super-heavy tank alone on a post-apocalyptic Earth. Face enemy tanks and alien beasts across deadly missions, and upgrade your tank to survive the escalating threats.

4555930.description: Ember Express is a sci-fi light yuri narrative adventure. Step into the role of a junior researcher at megacorporation COSMIC, uncover the truth behind the "Ember" incident, and rekindle a buried memory with your mysterious superior.

4576510.description: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 5 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.

4592180.description: Venture into a cursed town in this ruthless first-person survival horror game. With a hyper-realistic atmosphere and extreme survival mechanics, you'll need to ration your inventory and confront your worst nightmares to save your wife and daughter.

4613880.description: [Previously called "Tiny Towers"] A short incremental game about defending your tiny fortress from hordes of tiny mobs. Place towers, gain resources by defeating enemies, and unlock new upgrades in the skill tree to strengthen your goblin stronghold.

4622640.description: The demo of Pet the Cat is now available! In this lighthearted yet intense bullet-hell shooter, unleash attacks by “petting the cat” to fend off waves of relentless enemies! Experience the core gameplay and get an early taste of raising your cat into a battlefield powerhouse!

4624850.description: Write your own incantations and cast spells through your microphone! Battle in duels, team fights, or chaotic free-for-all matches with 25+ unique spells to learn, combo, and master.

4626900.description: Ride through explosive medieval streets on your pizza-powered scooter! Smash knights, dodge fire-breathing bats, and deliver piping-hot pizzas to wizards, goblins, and bizarre royalty! Loot crazy weapons, upgrade your scooter with absurd gadgets, and become an unstoppable delivery legend!

4634780.description: Momentum-based platforming built around expressive movement and tight gunplay. Master your elastic grappling hook to explore a vast, cyber-gothic megastructure, where robots piloted by the souls of the dead do penance for their sins.

videos.nom: Iron Bramble | Tokyo Game Show Trailer

4634920.description: A domineering CEO-like older sister who’s gentle only to her sister, a childhood friend who became her doctor, and a cheerful girl only she can see… Who was Chu Hebai before losing her memories, and how did she become entangled with them? A melancholic yuri AVG about regret and unspoken love.

4636730.description: Feed rubber ducks to a corporate void. Build physics contraptions. Chain combos for profit as the Maw grows hungrier... and larger. Brutalist PSX satire meets first-person sandbox chaos.

4638510.description: CH13: Rest Stop is a psychological horror game set in early 2000s Poland. What begins as a calm drive through the woods turns into something you weren't prepared for... Will you find out what awaits at the end of the road?

4639590.description: Tileburg is a game where each tile played has direct effects as well as powerful combos that trigger as soon as the conditions are met. Transform the landscape and develop your city while scoring points. Each turn, the city expands on a random tile!

4642580.description: An incremental journey about duck hunting with your canine companions. Shoot rare ducks, sell them, upgrade your abilities, and collect one billion ducks to combat world hunger!

4643980.description: Dungeon Crawler with elements of rogue-like and ARPG games. Kill hordes of enemies, duel mighty bosses, and acquire legendary loot!

4649960.description: Style and design your own Stuffy! Mix and match cosmetics, decorate unique outfits, and explore community creations in this free preview of Restitched's character customization mode.

4653050.description: Sushiamo is a roguelike deck-builder where you make sushi to reach absurd scores. Discover unique ingredients, sauces, game-changing tools, and navigate the map to break the game with insane combos!

4656370.description: The Last Shot: Underworld casts players in the role of an aging scientist who, by a sinister twist of fate, finds himself deep in the dungeons of Metropolis—a place inhabited by victims of monstrous experiments, rogue robots, and other unfortunate souls cast down to the depths.

4658500.description: Meaningless Random Numbers is an Incremental Horror Game about earning money through Random Number Generators but be cautious, God is Watching...

4659630.description: Play as Tony, a curious little mole with a serious digging habit, a taste for worms, and a dream of reaching the surface. Help townsfolk, repair gadgets, collect delightful hats, and explore hidden spaces as you uncover the story of Pebblegrove.

4661410.description: Build by day. Survive by night. Each day, use a limited number of actions to expand your city, manage resources, reinforce defenses, and prepare for what’s coming. Each night, your towers unleash their power against ever-growing zombie hordes.

4664400.description: Set in the world of Cultist Simulator, haunt mortals and escape divine punishment in this unique relationship and resource management game. Strike Faustian pacts, manipulate mortals, and forsake your immortal life. Developed by Common Logic via Weather Factory's Sixth History License.

4666230.description: You've been hired as a Part-Time Contract Packaging Worker at the fulfillment center.Can you find your own happiness amid the speeding conveyor belts and ever-growing list of rules?

videos.nom: XX Fulfillment Center Official Trailer - EN

4666390.description: From the creators of Nidhogg, murder hordes of monsters in this 2D platforming autoshooter with a killer soundtrack. Collect Blood, gold, and bones to increase your powers. Can you survive the Blood Dungeon?

4668060.description: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

4671750.description: Face a deluge of monsters in this incremental horde survivor FPS. Build your Bastion, level up your character, and upgrade your arsenal to rise from Apprentice Bell Ringer to Master Dragon Hunter.

4677940.description: Build your retail empire inside a shopping mall. Open multiple stores, sabotage rivals, and play solo or with up to 8 players. Choose different match objectives or play endless mode and compete for retail domination.

4678410.description: The Order sends you on a mission. Armed with technology powered by magic, build production chains, plan, transform, optimize, and prepare for the unexpected. In this automation roguelite, the Eye of the Order watches your moves: failure is only a step toward perfection.

4682290.description: Build your battle-top and become King of the Streets! Collect 60+ parts, Merge their Powers, and Dominate opponents in this Chill Roguelite! Skate around a vibrant Y2K city, winning Cash and Upgrades on your way to the top. And if you Die in the game, you Die in real life.

4683040.description: A first-person survival horror set in Neuquén, Argentine Patagonia. Venture into a remote estate in Cerro Ocaso to search for your missing partner. Face hordes of the undead, manage your resources, and solve classic puzzles to survive the nightmare.

4683720.description: This is the demo version of BioEden. Step into a cozy management journey as a Keeper and bring life back to a world quietly waiting to be healed. Craft the perfect biome for dozens of wonderful animal species and use your ingenuity to restore your planet, one ecosystem at a time.

4685250.description: Time travel to 1995 in this card-based computer hacking voyage. Take down an evil tech startup and shadowy government agency to become a god to the freaks and geeks of cyberspace. All while being helped by an incontinent virtual pug.

4689490.description: Experience a story-driven adventure game as a robot doctor. In a city of robots, illness is looming. Crack open ports and units to trace causes. Diagnose, repair and cross paths with robots and stories. Uncover secrets buried in the past and future, discover the truth that makes each robot unique.

4689730.description: Mine resources, build your spaceship, and soar through the skies in this immersive space sandbox. Wire complex machinery to survive the vacuum of space, and craft the StellarDrive: a powerful engine that lets you travel faster than light.

4691110.description: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.

4691560.description: As a small flea, explore a strange puzzle box full of secrets. Gather shapes and combine them to reveal hidden abilities. Polly is always watching… Can you escape?

4692540.description: Build your track, assemble your train and deliver cargo and carnage in equal amounts in this on-the-rails take on tower defense! This demo lets you play the first world as much as you'd like!

4694840.description: Outpour is a puzzle game where you redirect flowing water across dreamy cathedral rooftops. Manipulate your surroundings to guide a dynamic water system, traverse high places, and restore harmony to sacred structures.

4697990.description: An incremental ARPG about rising from a nobody to the most powerful assassin alive. Slash through waves of monsters, collect loot and upgrade your abilities. Get stronger with every run until even bosses become easy targets.

4698640.description: Escape the ocean depths in this casual incremental mining game. Mine, upgrade, and explore as your strength grows to crazy proportions, but don’t run out of oxygen!

4702340.description: False Hero is a fast-paced soulslike adventure where you steal your enemies’ attacks and chain them into deadly combos. Explore the corrupted Land of the Gods and put your combat skills to the true test in challenging boss fights. Will you fight for the Gods or become an apostle of Death?

4703050.description: Groove Core is a rhythm-based bullet heaven roguelike shooter where you arrange your weapons on a sequencer. Mix and match 200+ items, build your ship, and flood the cosmos with bullet storms as deadly as they are beautiful.

4714100.description: A dice-driven dark fantasy RPG inspired by solo tabletop adventures. Charge in sword in hand, talk your way out of danger, or ignore it all and keep walking. Every roll, every choice has a price. Handcrafted over six years by a 30-year Vanillaware veteran.

videos.nom: Witch of the Dark Castle PV01

4730760.description: This demo is about the first step. About the moment when familiar life, identical days, and endless routine begin to feel unbearable. When staying where you are becomes harder than taking a step into the unknown. Leave the colony and begin a journey whose meaning you have yet to understand.

4731370.description: Welcome to the MEOWFACTORY! Automate production lines and manage limited space to achieve perfection. Connect machines with conveyor lines and minimize hand (well, paw) labour! In the near and depressing future, when the world is on the verge of destruction, ONLY MEOWORKERS can revive production!

4733320.description: This is an eerie clicker idle game with light puzzles and idle combat. Alice wakes in darkness, trapped in a strange mansion, seeking escape. The Cat God's altar drops gold, Rabbitfolk gather carrots, and dungeon monsters block the way... Can you accompany Alice to the final truth?

4735110.description: A puzzle game about forging paintings using newspaper cutouts. Fool your legally blind boss or lose your job!

4737860.description: Deep beneath the world, an ancient god stirs. Master the forbidden power of DITTORI, discover its secrets, and use it to bend reality to your will. Herald the end of all things.

4739030.description: Pulsebreaker is a single-player survival horror game. Manage your scarce resources such as ammo, medicine, and tools to survive. Skill-based precision tactical combat utilizing headshots, contextual dodges, and melee attacks help beat back the undead. Explore a city teetering on the brink of doom.

4743990.description: Embark on a journey to reunite with your bread in this bite-sized 3D action-platformer featuring everyone's favorite shark! Jump through a lava fortress, fight a cool boss, and snag some hats along the way in this compact demo.

4758450.description: Skip stones as far as you can in this relaxing incremental game. Launch, bounce across the water, upgrade, and go further with every throw. Buy new upgrades and powers to become the ultimate stone skipper.

4760210.description: Another Door is a multiplayer, turn-based roguelike with monsters, despair, risk and betrayal. Hide your intentions, bluff to survive and bet on your luck. Will you back out, or venture through Another Door?

4769390.description: A first-person puzzle escape game set in a mansion that holds the remains of a freak show carnival. Meet the former stars of the show, now locked inside intricate contraptions. Venture into surreal worlds lurking between the cracks of reality and solve the workings of complex original machinery.

4772170.description: Litany is a roguelike deckbuilder where you play multiple units, craft a hyper-synergistic group, and trigger results that should not exist. Pick a character, open boosters, upgrade cards, and craft a powerful combination that breaks the numbers!

4776950.description: Cook authentic pizzas, manage your kitchen, serve impatient customers, and experience the first taste of Pizza House Simulator. The full game will expand into automation, customization, disasters, economy systems, and restaurant empire building.

4781580.description: An online co-op dark fantasy adventure game set in the underbelly of a consumer goods conglomerate mega dungeon. Within its halls you will fight ancient foes and modern horrors. Can you survive long enough to make it to the top?

4787870.description: Former developers from Bethesda, BioWare, and Naughty Dog bring you a sandbox RPG realm of anthropomorphic animals and fairy creatures. Play co-op or solo as you build a village of memorable NPCs, farm, craft, explore, and celebrate the seasons in an ever-changing world bigger than you.

4797010.description: Swing your scythe, earn coins, and spend them on a variety of upgrades to cut deeper into the overgrowth. An incremental action game about pushing further than anyone has gone before

4802880.description: Solve puzzles and collect stamps in the demo for this casual nonogram game!

4805850.description: Click the Button is an incremental game about clicking a button to receive chests that deliver incredible rewards. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

4809830.description: Burn. Build. Survive. Escape. Incinerate nightmares with the MATEJKO flamethrower, expand your ever-growing base, and unlock devastating new weapons. Every night the planet grows stronger. So do you. Recover forgotten memories and fight your way back home (with your chihuahua's help).

4810610.description: A class-based action MMO inspired by classic RPGs. Explore a fractured world of monsters and ruins, build your own playstyle, and fight alongside friends in real-time, cooperative combat.

4815630.description: Call in secret, strike deals, spread lies, and trust no one as you fight for control of the city. (Play with up to 6 players in the demo.)

4818830.description: Graphics and performance demo for Spaceflight Simulator 2. Explore stunning scenarios from low Earth orbit to the Moon’s surface and test how the game performs on your own device. The demo also includes a full planet editor for creating your own custom planets.

4819000.description: A genre-defining classic, rebuilt. Arma: Cold War Assault Remastered Demo brings the 2001 original's engine to modern 64-bit Windows & Linux. Free, open-source, and doubling as an official asset pack for your own Arma missions and mods.

4824970.description: A cozy pet simulation game starring a REAL dog! Share your days with Pichu, an adorable real-life Golden Retriever. Discover new walk locations, train, and play together as your bond grows stronger every day.

4825100.description: Curse Of The Abandoned Floor is a first-person Chinese-style horror game. It begins with a paranormal video, telling the urban legend: “Be very careful of the non-existent elevator gap. If you accidentally enter it, you will be trapped forever.” This is a demo.

4826310.description: 2409. As the new Spook on HMS Solbrand you dive deep into a past steeped in grand norse myth and quiet local legend. Command your submersible, survey sunken ruins, uncover puzzling fragments, commune with the dead, and begin to untangle a pseudo-historical knot of cosmic proportions.

4830460.description: Travel to the end of the world in this auto scroller RPG. Craft unique builds, discover powerful item combos, and transform your fragile stable boy into the Bestest Knight. In this DEMO version you can explore the first region and play until the rank of Elite Knight.

4852340.description: Build your dream car and drive through the '90s. Keikaku計画 is a simulation game where you get to experience both authentic car building and life in Japan, and rise to become a '90s street legend.

4857520.description: The dating simulator is alive and wants you... to date monsters! Your choices determine if they are kind or horrifying. Can you survive every encounter and discover something meaningful?

4866060.description: Build your own mining company in the coal region of Grubental! Construct your colliery above ground, descend into procedurally generated depths, and operate over 15 heavy machines. Master mine statics, infrastructure, complex transport networks, and sell your coal on dynamic markets.

4875130.description: Cold Sweat is a PvE single player extraction shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Collect loot, complete missions for traders, upgrade your base, customize your firearms, and shoot your way through other survivors and the undead.

4880830.description: 世纪交接的十年，港岛。一笔意外的投资让初出茅庐的剧作家姜韶平得以将首作搬上剧院舞台。这看似天降的机遇，却早已在暗中标好了筹码——渐行渐远的旧友、少时仰望的偶像、意外相识的神秘乐手、避而不见的至亲……谁能成为你的缪斯？谁又会将你推向深渊？亦或是，当掌声渐息，帷幕落下，还留在舞台上的，只有自己……

4881740.description: 'HollowCity' is a PvE top-down extraction shooter set in a ruined city. Solo or with up to 4 players, you must explore various zones and gather survival supplies. Hostile humans aren't the only threats to your life. Fight through monsters born from unknown causes and escape safely.

4883650.description: You complained to a strange roadside statue about being broke—and the next day, a jar of money appeared under your bed. How do you plan to spend this windfall? Of course, you’re free to squander every cent... as long as you can survive until tomorrow.

4891490.description: FLASK is a roguelike autobattler about alchemical greed on the new frontier. Build unstoppable homunculi, barter with mutated merchants, and slay hordes of monsters to harvest their valuable blood. It's time to get bloody... Bloody rich!

4893870.description: 'FMV Queen' Wang Han's First K-FMV! At your new job as a security guard in a women's only residence, feelings blossom between you and the charming residents, but strange events also haunt you from your first day. What mystery awaits you and the five ladies of Serena Villa?

4895870.description: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

4897890.description: Freaking Gamers is a 2D beat 'em up featuring fully hand-drawn artwork and stages packed with references to the iconic jokes and episodes from the Colônia Contra Ataca channel. Join the Freaking Gamers as they battle to stop the evil plans of Vinet, "the largest internet company in the world."

4905910.description: BLIGHTEN is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

4915820.description: A signal from a star // 3571 → 3559 → 3557 → … → 0 // 336 years remain // You and her, staring up at the sky. A hand-drawn sci-fi visual novel about first contact.

4918510.description: Sudokiller Demo is a cozy mystery puzzle game where you place suspects on a sudoku-style grid to unmask a killer hiding in plain sight. Every guest leaves a clue pinning down where they stood at the time of the murder. Deduce your way through case after case in this cozy, cleverly deceptive mystery.

4919590.description: Tend to a flock of sheep and build your perfect Mediterranean farm in this cozy ranch-builder! Decorate, expand, and create the perfect home for your fluffy friends. Yes, you can cuddle them.

4920000.description: You're a barber in a city full of beastfolk. Chat with your customers, style their look, help them see something new in the mirror... and in themselves.

4923940.description: I Like Trains is an incremental game about growing a single train line into a sprawling network full of trains, upgrades, and discovering strange anomalies along the way. Build, expand, and watch the map come to life while revealing the story within.

4925020.description: HIPS N' NOSES is a café management simulation! In a sleepless world, Mela is the only one who dreams. She runs a café that restores lost memories. Serve guests by day, battle in nightmares by night to collect the memory flower, customize your café, and become the most renowned owner!

videos.nom: HIPS N NOSE Official New Trailer

4936310.description: INFINITE CHUMP is an ultra-fast, boomer shooter roguelite tripfest where you graft spell-casting arms to your body. Put rings on your new fingers to create spells on the fly. Inspired by 90's FPS games with a trippy twist.

4940910.description: Happy Little Farm is a cozy incremental farming game where you grow a small, happy farm with cute animals. Plant crops, care for animals, and enjoy peaceful days. However, after the sun goes down, it may be best not to check whether the animals are truly happy.

4942610.description: Handshakes: Hands On is a wholesome puzzle game all about shaking hands. With puzzles designed to foster discovery and gently guide the player towards their own solution, you can play alone or with a friend and get your hands dirty in this simple and surprising puzzler.

4957140.description: A single-player, first-person psychological horror game. You wake up in a facility where every room wants you dead and a voice records everything. The worst trap is the other subjects: trust them, betray them, sacrifice yourself? Training modes playable by two, online or in split screen.

4965080.description: Mini Mart Survivors is a bullet heaven roguelite set in the mysterious SHIFT24 convenience store chain. Survive the night shift using convenience store items like cup noodles, snacks and coffee as weapons to fight off waves of strange customers.

4966120.description: An incremental game about flipping bottles, unlocking and upgrading unique abilities, and turning simple bottle flips into increasingly satisfying moments.

4968480.description: BREAKOUT BABY is a blood-pumping, Pac-Man–infused, first-person horror roguelike where you must help a poor baby escape to the surface. Run from creatures, scoop up pellets, and shake your baby to survive.

4971440.description: Grab your sawed-off, cast some sigils, and face the never ending nightmare head on in Venison County. Blast your old neighbors into undead venison giblets, master weapon specific active reloads, and limitlessly combine slain cultists' sigils for their sinful buffs (if you can withstand God's wrath).

4974580.description: Alchemortis is a roguelike inventory-management auto-battler about alchemy. Transmute and combine items to merge their stats, properties, and forms, then organize your inventory to unlock powerful synergies. Experiment, optimize, and craft the perfect build through the power of alchemy.

4991000.description: My Own Hero Party is an incremental idle game. Build your own band of heroes, venture deep into dungeons and gather mountains of gold! Invest your earnings in a permanent talent tree, grow stronger with every expedition and fight your way to the boss.

4992280.description: A cozy and spooky co-op adventure where two puppies rescue their owner from a haunted mansion. Customize your puppy, solve puzzles together, and defeat evil creatures. Play locally or invite a friend for free with Friend’s Pass.

5007130.description: Dive into a fast-paced open-world survival crafting game built around flashy, arcade-style combat. Discover powerful spells and power-ups, experiment with character builds, and push your limits through increasingly dangerous environments and intense boss fights.

5017320.description: A short rule-discovery puzzle game where you place alien symbols on a grid. Uncover their logic as you journey through an atmospheric solar system.

5018690.description: War isn't heroism, it's ruthless order and maneuver. Across 7 ages from the Stone Age to modern times, encircle the enemy, cut their supply, and break morale to melt them in the killbox. Lead veterans through Campaign, dive into fast Skirmishes, or mod tomorrow's wars with your own units!

5029110.description: Mine, merge, and automate! Combine ores into valuable resources, build compact production chains, unlock powerful machinery, and expand your cave into a bustling mining factory.

5056910.description: In a world where the paranormal is normal and jumpscares are lazy clichés, Illy signs up for a shady haunted house promising true psychological horror. The deal? Survive without getting scared and win $10,000! A totally, 100% jumpscare-free experience :)

videos.nom: The No Jumpscare Show - Demo Trailer

5057550.description: Once, in Times of Chaos is a live-action FMV espionage game set in Republican-era China. You will take on the role of an operative codenamed “Oak” and live through an extraordinary tale of intrigue in 1920s China.

videos.nom: 《隐藏真探》终极PV，定价公布，首发54元
等了这么久，终于定档了｜《隐藏真探》12月2日上线
隐藏真探 | 先导预告

5066740.description: A smuggled segment of the despicably detailed shooting simulator wrapped in a declassified computer program. Three weapons, dozens of cartridges and attachments, and absolutely nothing supernatural.

5072320.description: False Echo is a narrative cryptography thriller set in the darkest depths of the Stelantic, aboard a secret military submarine. Operate the Obscura machine, decode messages, and decide what gets through in a regime where even the smallest mistake means a huge death toll.

5072590.description: Spooky Tales is a horror anthology featuring four unique tales, blending 1920s pulp dread, Japanese body horror, found footage, and 80s VHS charm in one package.

5082360.description: A first-person pirate horror where a haunted fisherman is drawn into the legend of the Forsaken Fleet. Follow a mysterious compass. Sail through the fog. Explore forgotten places and survive the horrors that should have stayed buried at sea.

5085860.description: Your burger was stolen. Now everyone pays. Dash through fast-paced retro-inspired levels, chain kills to survive, unlock new weapons and upgrades, battle dangerous mafia enemies, and fight your way to the final boss in this adrenaline-fueled FPS.

5086270.description: Every hit is lethal, with no room for error. Switch between sword and pistol to tear through soldiers, artillery pieces, tanks — and even destroy an entire army. You awaken without memories. A queen claiming to be your wife asks you to fight for her. Will you stand with her to the end?

5086820.description: A group of friends looking for a weekend getaway are met with terror as one of them is mysteriously murdered. Trapped in an abandoned mansion deep in the Redwood Forest, they have no one to suspect but each other.

5095070.description: What if Hell made a mistake? Based on the testimony of a man who survived clinical death, this cinematic psychological horror challenges you to confront your fears and fight your way back to life, while something lurking in the darkness does everything it can to keep you among the damned forever.

5100290.description: Run your own ice cream shop in the Livin' the Cream demo! Serve customers, make Soft Serve and Scoop Ice Cream in three flavors, serve with different types of cones, and customize your shop with different floors, walls, counters, and tables.

5111690.description: Tainted Lands is a turn-based tactical RPG in an eldritch fantasy setting. Lead a band of adventurers to traverse a forbidden wilderness where ancient horrors lie in wait. Recruit companions, scavenge relics, and face the Outer Gods.

5120170.description: Cozy house renovation simulator where you renovate historic old ruins into luxury estates. Clean, restore & decorate homes in American, French, English, Spanish, Dutch, Japanese, Chinese & more styles. Uncovering the secret history of each home.

5123800.description: This demo contains the opening chapter of I SHALL NAME THE DEAD. Speak with the Nameless Dead, uncover their forgotten names, and begin your descent into the Necropolis before the Worm devours you from within.

5124070.description: Run an illegal gnome disposal business from your backyard. Build absurd traps and conveyor systems to maximize profit, and stop gnomes from sabotaging your shady operation before the whole neighborhood falls into chaos.

5124770.description: Welcome to Autolantis, a light roguelite strategy city builder where you rule an isolated continent and forge an empire of your own. Shape its future through Tiles, Workers, and Policies, unleash explosive automated production, and lead your empire to the pinnacle of civilization.

5131830.description: Experience the first chapter of our lovely adventuring RPG. As a humble herbalist, enjoy peaceful days in your home village. Gather nature's gifts, learn your first recipes, and lend a helping hand to those in need. Discover the joy and gratification of good deeds.

videos.nom: Hero of the Kingdom: Echoes Demo

5141740.description: You are the guardian of an infant god. Guide Aistalt through the toxic ruins of the internet. Debate with random users, harvest their ideologies, and sculpt her personality matrix. Will you raise a benevolent savior or a tyrant who deletes humanity?

5159140.description: Free demo of Octbuster, a physics sim meets a tidy-up game. Over 10,000 VHS tapes and an octopus with tentacle arms to scoop them up by the armful. A cart buddy, a kitten army, a buried arcade, co-op multiplayer, and no generative AI. Your save carries into the full game.

5166840.description: Character House: Desktop Companion is an idle collection game. Mix and match parts to create a companion that sits with you as you work, syncing with keystrokes, or watches from a corner. Earn rewards offline: pull and craft accessories, shape its personality, and visit friends online!

5176000.description: Sentenced to death, you're sent into the dark for one last chance at freedom. Solve interconnected puzzles, uncover secrets, face unique enemies with different behaviors, and make choices through dialogue. What you discover and decide will shape your story and determine how it ends.

5190130.description: Play a whole in-game day of Moto Courier Simulator for free: take orders, pack them right and ride 12 real-sounding bikes through San Verano – solo or with up to 4 friends in online co-op. When the day ends, keep free-riding as long as you like.

5198290.description: Restore the Grand Book Archive by sorting 2,990 books onto their rightful shelves. Use your observation and magical spells to organize the collection as quickly as possible. Explore a variety of book themes and discover endless possibilities within the archive.

5198350.description: Try Tavernia free. A strategy board game for 2–8 players. Answer trivia to claim empty tiles, then beat your opponents in minigame duels to take theirs. Play cards to challenge them to typing races, word puzzles, reaction tests, and more.

5208890.description: Wanted: a reliable technician who follows the rules, handles sensitive information with discretion, and does not ask questions. Fix the phones. Don't look too closely.

5213740.description: Run a haunted dark ride from the control booth in this spooky horror management sim. Load guests, trigger scares, route carts, and keep the power alive as the queue surges. Earn cash and prestige to rebuild the mansion, automate the ride, and survive every shift.

5213930.description: Take charge of a emergency room up to 8 players. Examine patients’ vitals, diagnose their conditions, and choose the right treatment. Prioritize emergencies and keep the shift under control as your patients’ conditions worsen around you.

5222090.description: You’re in charge of a run-down police station. Will you manage to restore it to its former glory? Arm yourself with some coffee and donuts, because there's a lot of renovation and micro-management work to do!

5233850.description: BLAST NAZI ZOMBIE HEADS (with friends)! Headshot Holdout is a retro, roguelite, FPS where squads of 1-4 start with only a rifle and build into zombie killing machines. There are no automatic weapons and no bullet sponge enemies. Strategy and accuracy are key.

5236990.description: Your little companion is an ambitious writer with very little discipline. Type, and they'll write too. Every keystroke moves their work forward. In this productivity game, help them become a renowned author while you get things done.

5246900.description: Celebrating the 20th anniversary of the PixelJunk Monsters series, the legendary series returns to its hand-drawn roots in glorious 4K! Run, dance, and build towers to defend against Monsters, with new roguelike elements adding strategic depth. Play solo or with up to two players online or locally.

5248110.description: Boomer Shooter Metroidvania. Nun with a gun. Because of the Malediction of the Moon, only devoted sisters with vows of silence can move freely in the city of Abbadox. So take up arms, Siléncia, and blast your way through these cobbled and winding streets!

5259290.description: Embark on an adventure across the ocean! In this captivating cooperative sailing game, one player commands the ship, while the other is confined to the captain's cabin, solely navigating with the map. Successfully completing your missions will require the crew's adept communication and skill.

5260550.description: Build a Safe Haven! An alchemy accident has devastated the mainland and the people are looking for a new home. Take the lead and rebuild society, house by house. HavenCraft is a third-person town builder and management game, playable in single- and multiplayer.

5272240.description: Lead a nation through a roguelike strategy campaign where borders grow continuously. Choose your path, unlock technology and push the front.

videos.nom: Story of The Needle In a Haystack

5307540.description: Millions of monsters are escaping the hole. Stop them with a unique arsenal of towers, nukes, and deep upgrades in this incremental tower defense game.

5328790.description: Customize your own character pair and put them on your desktop! Custom parts supported! Watch them talk and hang out on your screen, and share your creations with friends! Focus together in Focus Mode! Your pair sits beside you with a focus timer and a to-do list.

5346200.description: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together we must clear them all to reach paradise.

5357850.description: ALL 4 NAUGHT is a hack and slash roguelike where your party is your build. Recruit 4 heroes and swap between them mid-fight to combine their attacks and party-wide abilities. Delve into the dungeon, battle hordes of monsters, conquer brutal bosses, and build the perfect party!

5363200.description: PIZZAPOLY Demo is a chaotic co-op restaurant game where you run your own pizzeria with friends. Prepare pizzas, serve tables, handle online orders, hop on your scooter for deliveries, and survive the rush together.

5368860.description: Start a cult with friends and summon one of three rivalling gods. Sacrifice customers, perform dark rituals and work together to bring an ancient evil being into the world, all under the cover of a steakhouse.

5377740.description: Tower defense against a horde of thousands of slimes. Build walls, towers and traps along a funnel, pick level cards that bend each run, and watch the mass pile up, split and break through. Spend essence between runs to grow stronger.

5393850.description: TRACE is a rhythm game combining arcade-style elements with the precision and competitiveness of PC rhythm games. Follow the music and experience the full energy of an arcade in the comfort of your own home!

5398240.description: Seabun is an incremental 2D survivor-like with creature collection elements, where you play a scientist bunny diving deeper and deeper to find the source of the sea's corruption.
